words.enDefinition: a security income and expense used in professional practice

examples.en: The fund statement separates security income and expense on facing pages.
examples.zh: 基金报表把「证券收益及费用」分列在对开的两页上。

examples.en: Trustees questioned whether security income and expense should be netted or shown gross.
examples.zh: 受托人追问，「证券收益及费用」该轧差列示还是按总额披露。

words.enDefinition: rates applied to free market exchange

examples.en: Money changers on the street corner quote free market exchange rates all day.
examples.zh: 街角的换钱摊整天挂着「自由市场汇率」。

examples.en: Economists compare official pegs against free market exchange rates to gauge real pressure.
examples.zh: 经济学家用官方钉住汇率对比「自由市场汇率」，判断真实的贬值压力。

collocations: calculate the free market exchange rates
compare the free market exchange rates
reduce the free market exchange rates

words.enDefinition: financing arranged for bank

examples.en: The wind farm closed bank financing at six percent after two years of talks.
examples.zh: 谈了两年，风电场终于以6%的利率敲定「银行融资」。

examples.en: When bank financing dried up, the founders maxed out personal credit cards.
examples.zh: 「银行融资」断供后，创始人把个人信用卡刷到了极限。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to bank

examples.en: Dividend hunters bought bank stock after the payout was reinstated.
examples.zh: 分红恢复后，追求股息的投资者买入了「银行股票」。

examples.en: Regulators cap how much bank stock any single shareholder may hold.
examples.zh: 监管限制单一股东持有「银行股票」的比例上限。

words.enDefinition: the interest rate at which a central bank lends to commercial banks (or an official discount rate)

examples.en: The bank rate rose half a point, and mortgage offers vanished within days.
examples.zh: 「银行贴现率」上调半个百分点，房贷优惠几天内就消失了。

examples.en: Newspapers once printed the bank rate beside the weather, it moved so rarely.
examples.zh: 从前「银行贴现率」难得一动，报纸都把它排在天气预报旁边。

words.enDefinition: the benchmark interest rate banks charge their most creditworthy borrowers

examples.en: Small firms watch the bank prime rate because their credit lines float above it.
examples.zh: 小企业紧盯「最优惠贷款利率」，因为自己的授信额度是在它基础上上浮的。

examples.en: Every credit card contract pegs its variable APR to the bank prime rate.
examples.zh: 信用卡合同的浮动APR都钉在「最优惠贷款利率」上。

words.enDefinition: a bank authorised to issue banknotes

examples.en: Hong Kong's bank of issue prints its own banknotes under license.
examples.zh: 香港的「发钞银行」凭授权自行印制钞票。

examples.en: Collectors prize notes signed by a retired bank of issue from the 1920s.
examples.zh: 收藏者珍视1920年代已停业的「发钞银行」签发的纸币。

collocations: bank with the bank of issue
open an account at the bank of issue
deal with the bank of issue

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning bank

examples.en: Tight bank credit after the crisis pushed builders toward private lenders.
examples.zh: 危机后「银行信贷」收紧，建筑商转向了民间放贷人。

examples.en: Expanding bank credit lifts house prices until the rate cycle turns.
examples.zh: 「银行信贷」扩张会推高房价，直到利率周期转向。

words.enDefinition: debits charged to bank accounts

examples.en: Bank debits jumped the week the payroll cleared twice by mistake.
examples.zh: 工资误发两次的那一周，「银行借项」猛增。

examples.en: Statement lines list the bank debits with their reference numbers.
examples.zh: 对账单逐行列出各笔「银行借项」及其摘要号。

words.enDefinition: funds deposited with banks

examples.en: Bank deposits doubled at the rural branch once the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工厂开业后，乡村网点的「银行存款」翻了一倍。

examples.en: Deposit insurance reassures customers, so bank deposits rarely flee in small panics.
examples.zh: 有了存款保险，小风浪中「银行存款」很少外逃。

words.enDefinition: the insolvency of a bank

examples.en: Rumors of bank insolvency emptied three branch offices before noon.
examples.zh: 「银行无力偿债」的传闻让三家网点不到中午就被取空。

examples.en: The deposit fund stepped in at the first sign of bank insolvency.
examples.zh: 一有「银行无力偿债」的苗头，存款保险基金就会介入。

words.enDefinition: the bank's selling rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Always compare the bank's selling rate with the mid-market rate before exchanging.
examples.zh: 换汇前，务必把「银行卖价」与市场中间价比一比。

examples.en: The bank's selling rate for euros includes a three percent margin.
examples.zh: 欧元的「银行卖价」里含了3%的价差。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning banker's acceptance

examples.en: The importer settled the grain purchase through a banker's acceptance credit.
examples.zh: 进口商通过「银行承兑的信贷」结算了这批粮食货款。

examples.en: A banker's acceptance credit lets the seller bank discount the paper early.
examples.zh: 有了「银行承兑的信贷」，卖方银行可以提前贴现票据。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The deal closed only once the banker's commercial credit was issued.
examples.zh: 直到「银行商业信用证」开出，这笔交易才正式落定。

examples.en: Mismatched shipping papers can void the protection of a banker's commercial credit.
examples.zh: 装运单据对不上，「银行商业信用证」的保障就作废了。

words.enDefinition: the banker's rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Ask for the banker's rate before accepting the airport kiosk quote.
examples.zh: 接受机场柜台的报价之前，先问问「银行汇价」。

examples.en: The banker's rate on yen transfers improved after the merger.
examples.zh: 并购之后，日元汇款的「银行汇价」变好了。

words.enDefinition: a business activity or transaction carried out by a bank

examples.en: Each banking operation, from deposits to settlement, runs through the core system.
examples.zh: 从存款到清算，每一项「银行业务」都跑在核心系统上。

examples.en: Opening abroad means licensing every banking operation separately in each country.
examples.zh: 到海外开业，每项「银行业务」都要在各国单独拿牌照。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for funded

examples.en: The board topped up the funded reserve before approving the special dividend.
examples.zh: 批准特别股息之前，董事会先把「提存准备」补足。

examples.en: Auditors confirmed the funded reserve sits in real assets, not promises.
examples.zh: 审计师确认「提存准备」背后是真金白银的资产，不是空头承诺。

words.zhGloss: 以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付
words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to funded debenture
acceptedZhAnswers: 以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付

examples.en: The railroad chose funded debenture interest, rolling coupons into new bonds instead of cash.
examples.zh: 铁路把票息滚入新债，采用「以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付」来周转。

examples.en: Creditors accepted funded debenture interest once the court approved the reorganization.
examples.zh: 法院批准重组方案后，债权人接受了「以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付」的安排。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to sales of investment

examples.en: Sales of investment securities funded the bridge loan without touching deposits.
examples.zh: 靠「投资证券的销售」筹到了过桥贷款，存款分文未动。

examples.en: Quarterly statements disclose sales of investment securities with realized gains.
examples.zh: 季报披露「投资证券的销售」及其已实现收益。

words.enDefinition: safe-deposit custody of valuables, typically in a bank vault

examples.en: Grandma keeps the deed and her rings under safe deposit at the branch.
examples.zh: 祖母把地契和戒指都放在网点的「保险箱保管」里。

examples.en: Safe deposit boxes require two keys: yours and the bank's.
examples.zh: 「保险箱保管」需要两把钥匙同时转动：你的和银行的。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the unlisted type

examples.en: The parish financed its hall through unlisted bonds sold only to parishioners.
examples.zh: 教区通过只卖给信众的「未上证券市场的债券」筹资建堂。

examples.en: Unlisted bonds trade by phone among a handful of dealers.
examples.zh: 「未上证券市场的债券」只在少数交易商之间电话询价成交。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with dividend paying

examples.en: Investors screen for a dividend paying company with debt below two times earnings.
examples.zh: 投资者筛选「股利支付公司」，还要求负债不超过盈利的两倍。

examples.en: A dividend paying company rarely burns cash on reckless acquisitions.
examples.zh: 「股利支付公司」一般不会把现金烧在鲁莽的收购上。

collocations: open an account at the dividend paying company
deal with the dividend paying company

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to dividend

examples.en: Telecom shares remain the classic dividend stock for income-hungry retirees.
examples.zh: 电信股一直是收息退休族眼中经典的「股利股份」。

examples.en: Cutting the payout turned the market's favorite dividend stock into a warning tale.
examples.zh: 削减分红后，市场最爱的「股利股份」成了警世故事。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for additional

examples.en: The board approved additional funds for the recall before year-end.
examples.zh: 董事会在年底前批准了召回行动的「追加资金」。

examples.en: Rain damage forced the parish to request additional funds from the diocese.
examples.zh: 雨灾之后，教区不得不向主教区申请「追加资金」。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with additional paid-in

examples.en: The funding round added thirty million to additional paid-in capital.
examples.zh: 本轮融资给「附加资本」科目增加了3000万。

examples.en: Additional paid-in capital grows when investors pay above the par value of shares.
examples.zh: 投资者以超面值价格入股时，「附加资本」就会增加。

words.enDefinition: a charge payable for agent bank

examples.en: The syndicate split a one percent agent bank fee among the lenders.
examples.zh: 银团把1%的「代理银行费用」在成员行之间分摊。

examples.en: Borrowers negotiated the agent bank fee down to a flat fifty thousand.
examples.zh: 借款人把「代理银行费用」谈到固定5万的包干价。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from underwriting

examples.en: The IPO priced badly, so the syndicate's underwriting profit nearly vanished.
examples.zh: IPO定价失手，银团的「包销证券利润」几乎归零。

examples.en: In the bubble years, underwriting profit on new issues outearned all trading desks.
examples.zh: 泡沫年代，新股「包销证券利润」超过了所有交易台的进账。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to undigested

examples.en: The syndicate still holds undigested securities from the botched winter offering.
examples.zh: 冬季那次发行搞砸了，银团手里还压着「未售出的证券」。

examples.en: Undigested securities weigh on the price until the underwriters quietly place them.
examples.zh: 「未售出的证券」会压制股价，直到承销商悄悄消化完。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to equalizing

examples.en: The board paid an equalizing dividend to top up the lean previous year.
examples.zh: 董事会派发「调剂历年股利」，把上一年的歉收补齐。

examples.en: Most shareholders noticed the equalizing dividend only deep in the footnotes.
examples.zh: 多数股东只在报表附注深处才注意到「调剂历年股利」。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to active

examples.en: Market makers only quote active securities where spreads stay razor thin.
examples.zh: 做市商只为「交易活跃的证券」报价，那里的价差薄如刀片。

examples.en: Illiquid bonds behave nothing like active securities during a rout.
examples.zh: 大跌时，冷门债券的表现与「交易活跃的证券」完全两样。

words.enDefinition: a market for active

examples.en: Fair value needs an active market; without one, models take over.
examples.zh: 公允价值需要「活跃市场」，否则就只能靠模型说话。

examples.en: The sell-off proved which positions had an active market behind them.
examples.zh: 这轮抛售检验出了哪些头寸背后真有「活跃市场」。

collocations: clear goods through the active market

words.enDefinition: a market for easiness of money

examples.en: Traders enjoyed the easiness of money market conditions, borrowing nearly for nothing.
examples.zh: 交易员享受着「市场利率低」的宽松日子，借钱几乎不要成本。

examples.en: The easiness of money market conditions ended the day the central bank blinked.
examples.zh: 央行一出手，「市场利率低」的宽松日子就到头了。

collocations: secure the easiness of money market
visit the easiness of money market
lease the easiness of money market

words.enDefinition: capital associated with subscribed

examples.en: The founders' subscribed capital of two hundred thousand anchors the new company.
examples.zh: 创始人「认缴资本」20万，构成新公司的底座。

examples.en: Subscribed capital converts to paid-in capital as each installment actually arrives.
examples.zh: 每一笔实缴到账，「认缴资本」就转成实收资本。

words.zhGloss: 附属公司(子公司)的股利
words.enDefinition: distributions of profits related to subsidiary stock
acceptedZhAnswers: 附属公司(子公司)的股利

examples.en: The parent waits for subsidiary stock dividends before planning group payouts.
examples.zh: 母公司先看「附属公司（子公司）的股利」，再规划集团分红。

examples.en: Consolidation eliminates subsidiary stock dividends to avoid double-counting group profit.
examples.zh: 合并报表抵销「附属公司（子公司）的股利」，避免集团利润重复计算。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to substituted

examples.en: Collateral swaps release substituted securities into the pool every quarter.
examples.zh: 每季度质押置换后，「代替证券」就会进入抵押池。

examples.en: Trustees must approve substituted securities before the old collateral is released.
examples.zh: 旧抵押品放行之前，「代替证券」必须先经受托人批准。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for exchange stabilization

examples.en: The exchange stabilization fund stepped in when the peso slid past seven.
examples.zh: 比索跌破7之后，「外汇平准基金」出手了。

examples.en: Reserves for the exchange stabilization fund shrank for a third straight month.
examples.zh: 「外汇平准基金」的储备连续第三个月缩水。

words.enDefinition: dealers exempted from a regulatory requirement
acceptedZhAnswers: 可为自己买卖证券的商人

examples.en: Exempted dealers may trade for their own account without a full license.
examples.zh: 「豁免交易商」可以为自己的账户买卖证券，无需完整牌照。

examples.en: Regulators tightened reporting duties on exempted dealers after the flash rally.
examples.zh: 闪电式反弹之后，监管收紧了对「豁免交易商」的报告要求。

words.enDefinition: a hazard or risk arising in trade

examples.en: Piracy remains the classic trade hazard on the gulf route.
examples.zh: 海湾航线上，海盗仍是最典型的「贸易风险」。

examples.en: The contract assigns every trade hazard to the buyer once goods cross the ship's rail.
examples.zh: 合同约定，货物一旦越过船舷，「贸易风险」全部转移给买方。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from extensive

examples.en: Extensive investment spread the group across ten provinces before discipline returned.
examples.zh: 纪律回归之前，集团的「外延投资」铺到了十个省。

examples.en: Analysts now prefer intensive gains over extensive investment in new acreage.
examples.zh: 分析师如今更看重集约化收益，而非新垦土地上的「外延投资」。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the annuity type

examples.en: Annuity bonds repay a little of everything—principal and interest—in equal installments.
examples.zh: 「年金债券」本息合在一起，按相等的分期逐年偿还。

examples.en: Housing agencies financed estates with annuity bonds repayable over thirty years.
examples.zh: 住房机构以三十年期的「年金债券」为楼盘融资。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning insurance

examples.en: Read the exclusions page of the insurance contract before the flood season.
examples.zh: 汛期来临前，先读一读「保险契约」的免责条款页。

examples.en: The insurer denied the claim citing a clause buried in the insurance contract.
examples.zh: 保险公司引用「保险契约」深处的一条条款，拒绝了赔付。

words.zhGloss: 保险业者向股票的投资
words.enDefinition: a unit of ownership related to insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险业者向股票的投资

examples.en: The regulator tracks the insurance share of listed equities each quarter.
examples.zh: 监管机构每季度跟踪「保险业者向股票的投资」情况。

examples.en: After the crash, insurers trimmed their insurance share to protect solvency margins.
examples.zh: 股灾之后，保险公司压缩「保险业者向股票的投资」，以保住偿付能力。

words.zhGloss: 在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行
words.enDefinition: banks whose deposits are protected by deposit insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行

examples.en: Insured banks display the FDIC decal beside every teller window.
examples.zh: 「在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行」在每个柜员窗口旁都贴着FDIC标识。

examples.en: Depositors moved balances to insured banks the week rumors spread.
examples.zh: 传闻一起，储户当周就把余额搬进了「在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行」。

words.enDefinition: loans related to international syndicated bank

examples.en: The refinery closed international syndicated bank loans from twelve lenders across three continents.
examples.zh: 炼油厂拿到了横跨三大洲、12家银行组成的「国际银团贷款」。

examples.en: International syndicated bank loans share documentation standards set in London and New York.
examples.zh: 「国际银团贷款」沿用伦敦和纽约确立的统一文本标准。

collocations: arrange the international syndicated bank loans
monitor the international syndicated bank loans
repay the international syndicated bank loans

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to commercial loan

examples.en: Our commercial loan rate floats at three points over the benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们的「商业贷款利率」按基准利率上浮3个点。

examples.en: The commercial loan rate for retailers climbed twice this spring.
examples.zh: 今春零售业的「商业贷款利率」两度上调。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with commercial investment trust

examples.en: The commercial investment trust company pooled shopkeepers' savings into property.
examples.zh: 这家「商业投资信托公司」把小店主的积蓄汇集起来投向物业。

examples.en: Depositors moved to the commercial investment trust company chasing double-digit coupons.
examples.zh: 为了两位数的票息，储户纷纷转投「商业投资信托公司」。

collocations: engage the commercial investment trust company
bank with the commercial investment trust company
instruct the commercial investment trust company

words.enDefinition: capital associated with interest on

examples.en: Partnership deeds often fix interest on capital at six percent flat.
examples.zh: 合伙协议常把「资本利息」固定在6%。

examples.en: Interest on capital is paid before profits are shared among partners.
examples.zh: 先付「资本利息」，再在合伙人之间分配利润。

words.enDefinition: securities that cannot be easily sold or transferred to other investors

examples.en: Savings bonds are classic non-marketable securities, transferable only by gift or death.
examples.zh: 储蓄国债是典型的「非流通证券」，只能因赠与或继承而转让。

examples.en: Valuing non-marketable securities demands a hefty discount for the missing exit.
examples.zh: 给「非流通证券」估值，得为卖不出去这点打个大折扣。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in non-stock

examples.en: Universities often organize as a non-stock corporation with members instead of shareholders.
examples.zh: 大学常注册为「非股份公司」，只有成员而没有股东。

examples.en: A non-stock corporation reinvests every surplus instead of paying dividends.
examples.zh: 「非股份公司」把全部盈余再投入，从不分红。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with non-stock

examples.en: The symphony is a non-stock company run by its board of trustees.
examples.zh: 这支交响乐团是理事会治理的「非股份公司」。

examples.en: Without shares to sell, a non-stock company raises funds through memberships.
examples.zh: 没有股份可卖，「非股份公司」只能靠会费筹资。

words.enDefinition: the cost of floatation

examples.en: Underwriting fees pushed the cost of floatation to four percent of proceeds.
examples.zh: 承销费把「筹资成本」推到了募资额的4%。

examples.en: Smaller issues suffer a brutal cost of floatation because fixed fees bite harder.
examples.zh: 规模越小的发行，「筹资成本」越惨，固定费用分摊起来更狠。

words.enDefinition: a bank that provides services on behalf of another bank

examples.en: Our correspondent bank in Nairobi clears every payment in the region.
examples.zh: 内罗毕的「往来银行」替我们清算整个地区的付款。

examples.en: Without a correspondent bank abroad, small exporters wait weeks for dollars.
examples.zh: 海外没有「往来银行」，小出口商的美元要等上几个星期。

words.enDefinition: finance related to corporation

examples.en: Corporation finance asks one question: does this investment beat its funding cost?
examples.zh: 「公司理财」只问一个问题：这项投资能否跑赢它的资金成本。

examples.en: Her corporation finance class built actual valuation models for local businesses.
examples.zh: 她的「公司理财」课为本地企业搭建真实的估值模型。

words.enDefinition: an increase in value arising from net capital

examples.en: Subtracting last year's losses left a net capital gain of twelve thousand.
examples.zh: 抵掉去年的亏损后，「净资本利得」为1.2万。

examples.en: The tax form separates ordinary income from net capital gain.
examples.zh: 税表把普通所得与「净资本利得」分开申报。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with live on

examples.en: After selling the shop, they learned to live on capital for exactly one year.
examples.zh: 卖掉店铺后，他们整整一年「靠资本生活」。

examples.en: Financial advisors warn that choosing to live on capital too early drains the whole pile.
examples.zh: 理财顾问提醒：过早决定「靠资本生活」，会把老本整个掏空。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from contingent credit

examples.en: Guarantees create contingent credit risk that only shows up when borrowers fail.
examples.zh: 担保孕育着「或有信用风险」，只在借款人倒下时才显形。

examples.en: The bank stress-tests contingent credit risk from its off-balance-sheet guarantees.
examples.zh: 银行对表外担保带来的「或有信用风险」做压力测试。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with management-investment

examples.en: A management-investment company earns fees for running the pooled portfolios.
examples.zh: 「管理投资公司」靠打理集合资产组合赚取管理费。

examples.en: Regulators classify it as a management-investment company, not a passive fund.
examples.zh: 监管把它的性质定为「管理投资公司」，而非被动型基金。

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing commercial

examples.en: Tariff hikes overnight reshaped the country's commercial policy on imports.
examples.zh: 关税一夜间重塑了国家的进口「商业政策」。

examples.en: Trade partners studied the new commercial policy before committing to supply deals.
examples.zh: 贸易伙伴研读新的「商业政策」，再决定是否签供货合同。

words.enDefinition: a market maker used in professional practice

examples.en: The market maker quotes both sides, earning the spread a thousand times a day.
examples.zh: 「做市商」双边报价，一天赚上千次价差。

examples.en: When the market maker stepped back, the stock traded in wild gaps.
examples.zh: 「做市商」一撤，这只股票的成交就变得七零八落。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with investment managing

examples.en: The county hired an investment managing agency to run its reserves.
examples.zh: 县里聘请「投资经营代理行」来管理结余资金。

examples.en: Fees at the investment managing agency undercut hiring a full treasury team.
examples.zh: 「投资经营代理行」的收费，比自建资金团队更划算。

words.enDefinition: a manager responsible for investment

examples.en: Our investment manager rebalanced into utilities the week rates peaked.
examples.zh: 利率见顶那一周，「投资管理人」把组合调向了公用事业股。

examples.en: Ask any investment manager what they did in 2008 and you get a story.
examples.zh: 问任何一位「投资管理人」2008年做了什么，你都会听到一段故事。

words.enDefinition: enterprises engaged in investment in productive

examples.en: Development banks favor investment in productive enterprises over pure property plays.
examples.zh: 开发银行偏爱「生产企业投资」，胜过单纯的地产炒作。

examples.en: The fund's investment in productive enterprises created four hundred factory jobs.
examples.zh: 基金的「生产企业投资」创造了四百个工厂岗位。

words.enDefinition: interests in investment

examples.en: His investment interests span four wineries and a logistics group.
examples.zh: 他的「投资股权」横跨四家酒庄和一家物流集团。

examples.en: Divorce court untangled overlapping investment interests in the family holding company.
examples.zh: 离婚诉讼理清了家族控股公司里交叠的「投资股权」。

words.enDefinition: units of ownership related to investment company

examples.en: Grandma bought investment company shares at the drugstore counter in 1962.
examples.zh: 1962年，祖母在药店柜台上买下了「投资公司股票」。

examples.en: Investment company shares trade at a premium when the manager's reputation soars.
examples.zh: 经理人声望高涨时，「投资公司股票」会溢价交易。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to premium

examples.en: Blue-chip insurers count as premium stock in most defensive portfolios.
examples.zh: 蓝筹保险股在多数防御型组合中都属于「高信誉的股票」。

examples.en: Even premium stock slid thirty percent when the scandal broke.
examples.zh: 丑闻一爆发，连「高信誉的股票」也跌了三成。

words.enDefinition: the printed certificate evidencing ownership of a bond

examples.en: The leather portfolio still holds her grandfather's bond certificate from 1948.
examples.zh: 皮夹里还留着祖父1948年的「债券证书」。

examples.en: Bond certificates were printed with ornate borders and perforated coupon sheets.
examples.zh: 旧时的「债券证书」印着华丽花边，还带一排可撕的息票。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for bond investment

examples.en: The bond investment trust pools small savers' money into municipal issues.
examples.zh: 这家「债券投资信托公司」把小储户的钱集中投向市政债。

examples.en: Distributions from the bond investment trust arrive on the fifth monthly.
examples.zh: 「债券投资信托公司」的分红每月五号准时到账。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from bond

examples.en: Bond investment suits savers who lose sleep over every stock swing.
examples.zh: 「债券投资」适合那些被股价波动搅得睡不好觉的储户。

examples.en: The endowment shifted twenty percent of its bond investment into shorter maturities.
examples.zh: 捐赠基金把两成「债券投资」挪到了较短期限上。

words.enDefinition: yield earned from bond

examples.en: The bond yield jumped forty basis points after the inflation report.
examples.zh: 通胀数据公布后，「债券收益率」跳升40个基点。

examples.en: Compare each bond yield with the ten-year Treasury before buying anything.
examples.zh: 买之前，把每支「债券收益率」跟十年期国债比一比。

words.enDefinition: a register of bond

examples.en: The registrar's bond register lists every holder of the railway loan since 1912.
examples.zh: 登记处的「债券登记簿」记下了1912年以来铁路贷款的每一位持有人。

examples.en: Transfers only count once they are entered in the bond register.
examples.zh: 过户只有登记进「债券登记簿」才算数。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for bond retirement

examples.en: One cent of every ticket sale feeds the stadium's bond retirement fund.
examples.zh: 每张球票提一美分，注入体育场的「债券偿债基金」。

examples.en: The bond retirement fund bought back notes early when rates fell.
examples.zh: 利率一降，「债券偿债基金」就提前回购了票据。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for bond sinking

examples.en: The bond sinking fund accumulates quarterly deposits until the balloon payment comes due.
examples.zh: 「债券偿债基金」每季度归集资金，一直攒到大额到期日。

examples.en: Trustees certify the bond sinking fund balance before every coupon date.
examples.zh: 每个付息日前，受托人都要核证「债券偿债基金」余额。

words.enDefinition: subscriptions to purchase newly issued bonds

examples.en: Bond subscriptions from employees alone covered a third of the new issue.
examples.zh: 仅员工「认缴债券」就占到新发行的三分之一。

examples.en: Bond subscriptions closed within hours once the ceiling was reached.
examples.zh: 认购额度一满，「认缴债券」几小时内就截止了。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates cost-benefit

examples.en: The levee passed review with a cost-benefit ratio of five to one.
examples.zh: 防洪堤以5:1的「成本-收益率」通过审查。

examples.en: Anything below a cost-benefit ratio of one never survives the budget round.
examples.zh: 「成本-收益率」低于1的项目，绝难过预算审查这一关。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with paid-in

examples.en: Paid-in capital of five hundred thousand finally let the clinic order equipment.
examples.zh: 「实收资本」到账50万后，诊所终于下了设备订单。

examples.en: Paid-in capital only counts once the money truly sits in the bank.
examples.zh: 只有真金白银进了银行账户，「实收资本」才算数。

words.enDefinition: recovery of costs through charges or proceeds

examples.en: The utility filed for cost recovery on the storm repairs.
examples.zh: 电力公司就风灾抢修申请「成本补偿」。

examples.en: Ratepayers disputed the cost recovery request, calling the repairs long overdue maintenance.
examples.zh: 用户质疑这笔「成本补偿」，说那不过是拖了太久的日常维护。

words.enDefinition: a short-term loan used to finance day-to-day business operations

examples.en: An operating loan bridges the gap between planting season and harvest receipts.
examples.zh: 一笔「经营周转贷款」，正好衔接播种期与收成回款之间的空档。

examples.en: The co-op repaid its operating loan the week the soybeans shipped.
examples.zh: 大豆一发货，合作社当周就还清了「经营周转贷款」。

words.enDefinition: management of credit risk

examples.en: Credit risk management begins with limits per sector, not with hope.
examples.zh: 「信贷风险管理」从设定行业限额开始，而不是靠祈祷。

examples.en: Her team overhauled credit risk management after two defaulting chains.
examples.zh: 两条连锁企业违约后，她的团队彻底重构了「信贷风险管理」。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of fixed-interest debt to equity in a company's capital structure

examples.en: High capital gearing means small profit swings magnify into wild equity returns.
examples.zh: 「资本杠杆比率」高企时，利润的小幅波动会被放大成股东回报的剧烈起伏。

examples.en: Housebuilders cut their capital gearing long before the rate cycle turned.
examples.zh: 房建商赶在利率周期转向之前，早早压低了「资本杠杆比率」。

words.enDefinition: money received from capital

examples.en: Rent, dividends, and capital gains all count as capital income for the surtax.
examples.zh: 房租、股息和资本利得都计入附加税的「资本所得」。

examples.en: Retirees now draw more capital income than wages from their holdings.
examples.zh: 如今退休族从持仓获得的「资本所得」超过了工资。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by perpetual

examples.en: A perpetual loan pays interest forever and never asks for the principal back.
examples.zh: 「永续贷款」永远只付利息，从不过问本金归还。

examples.en: Two endowed halls were built on perpetual loans from a nineteenth-century benefactor.
examples.zh: 两座学院厅舍的建造资金，来自十九世纪恩主的「永续贷款」。

words.enDefinition: a market for call-money

examples.en: Brokers park overnight surpluses in the call-money market before opening.
examples.zh: 开盘前，经纪商把隔夜富余资金放进「拆息市场」。

examples.en: Tightness in the call-money market spread to longer maturities within days.
examples.zh: 「拆息市场」的紧张几天内就蔓延到了更长期限。

words.enDefinition: a capital expenditure and receipt used in professional practice

examples.en: The council publishes capital expenditure and receipt forecasts beside the tax rate.
examples.zh: 市政会公布「资本的收支」预测，与税率并列。

examples.en: Borrowing fills the gap whenever capital expenditure and receipt drift apart.
examples.zh: 「资本的收支」一旦失衡，缺口就得靠举债来填。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for capital

examples.en: The capital budget for new trams passed by one vote.
examples.zh: 新电车的「资本预算」以一票之差获得通过。

examples.en: Deferring the capital budget today doubles the fleet replacement bill tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今天推迟「资本预算」，明天的车队更新账单就要翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for cash flow

examples.en: The treasurer built a cash flow budget down to weekly payroll outflows.
examples.zh: 资金主管把「资金流动预算」细化到每周的工资支出。

examples.en: Their cash flow budget predicted the overdraft spike to the very week.
examples.zh: 他们的「资金流动预算」把透支高峰精确到了那一周。

words.zhGloss: 连同汇兑费用一并支付
words.enDefinition: the conversion or marketplace related to payable with
acceptedZhAnswers: 连同汇兑费用一并支付

examples.en: The invoice was drawn payable with exchange, so fees rode on top.
examples.zh: 发票开成「连同汇兑费用一并支付」，手续费就加在票面之上。

examples.en: Collectors abroad learned that drafts payable with exchange cost more than face value.
examples.zh: 国外收款方发现，「连同汇兑费用一并支付」的汇票实际成本高于票面。

words.zhGloss: 有现金股利收入的股票
words.enDefinition: a unit of ownership related to cash generated
acceptedZhAnswers: 有现金股利收入的股票

examples.en: Retirees chase every cash generated share that pays quarterly without fail.
examples.zh: 退休族追逐每一只按季稳定派现的「有现金股利收入的股票」。

examples.en: A cash generated share cushions the portfolio when growth names wobble.
examples.zh: 成长股摇晃时，「有现金股利收入的股票」能为组合兜底。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from performance

examples.en: Late steel deliveries transferred the performance risk squarely onto the exporter.
examples.zh: 钢材迟交，把「履行合同的风险」实实在在压到了出口商头上。

examples.en: The standby letter of credit exists precisely to cover performance risk.
examples.zh: 备用信用证的存在，正是为了覆盖这类「履行合同的风险」。

words.enDefinition: a discounted rate of return used in professional practice

examples.en: The project's discounted rate of return of eleven percent beats our hurdle by two points.
examples.zh: 项目「贴现投资收益率」为11%，比我们的门槛高出2个点。

examples.en: Analysts recompute the discounted rate of return whenever fuel assumptions change.
examples.zh: 燃油假设一变，分析师就重算「贴现投资收益率」。

collocations: calculate the discounted rate of return
compare the discounted rate of return
interpret the discounted rate of return

words.enDefinition: capacity for earning

examples.en: The valuation rests on the plant's earning capacity, not its replacement cost.
examples.zh: 这座工厂的估值看的是「收益能力」，而不是重置成本。

examples.en: Two bad harvests in a row halved the orchard's earning capacity.
examples.zh: 连续两年歉收，果园的「收益能力」被腰斩。

words.enDefinition: a debenture for subordinate

examples.en: Subordinate debenture holders stand behind every secured lender at liquidation.
examples.zh: 清算时，「附属信用公司债」持有人排在所有有担保债权人之后。

examples.en: Higher coupons are the price of holding subordinate debenture paper.
examples.zh: 拿着「附属信用公司债」的代价，就是更高的票息。

words.enDefinition: debentures backed by a guarantee

examples.en: The parent's guarantee turned the subsidiary's paper into guaranteed debentures.
examples.zh: 母公司的担保让子公司的债券成为「有保证的企业债券」。

examples.en: Pension funds buy guaranteed debentures precisely because an insurer stands behind them.
examples.zh: 养老基金买「有保证的企业债券」，图的就是背后有保险机构撑着。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to operating earning

examples.en: The division's operating earning rate of nine percent finally cleared its charge for capital.
examples.zh: 该事业部「营业资本收益率」达9%，终于覆盖了资本占用费。

examples.en: Weak operating earning rate forced the division to shed two product lines.
examples.zh: 「营业资本收益率」疲软，事业部砍掉了两条产品线。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to call

examples.en: The call rate spiked the afternoon cash ran short on the Street.
examples.zh: 现金告急的那个下午，「通知贷款利率」一路飙升。

examples.en: Dealers borrow at the call rate and lend it out by lunch.
examples.zh: 交易商上午按「通知贷款利率」借入，中午前就转手放出。

words.zhGloss: 权益年金人寿保险公司
words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with equity annuity life insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 权益年金人寿保险公司

examples.en: The equity annuity life insurance company guarantees a floor on every retirement payout.
examples.zh: 这家「权益年金人寿保险公司」为每笔退休给付保底。

examples.en: Pension consultants compared three equity annuity life insurance company quotes before recommending one.
examples.zh: 养老顾问比较了三家「权益年金人寿保险公司」的报价才作推荐。

collocations: classify equity annuity life insurance company
measure equity annuity life insurance company
disclose equity annuity life insurance company

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates net worth to debts

examples.en: A net worth to debts ratio above two comforts most lenders.
examples.zh: 「净值对负债比率」高于2，多数放贷方就安心了。

examples.en: Years of buybacks dragged the net worth to debts ratio toward one.
examples.zh: 多年回购下来，「净值对负债比率」被拖向1。

collocations: calculate the net worth to debts ratio
compare the net worth to debts ratio
interpret the net worth to debts ratio

words.zhGloss: 资本投资中工程项目的选择
words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from project selection in capital
acceptedZhAnswers: 资本投资中工程项目的选择

examples.en: Project selection in capital investment starts with a ranked list, not wishful thinking.
examples.zh: 「资本投资中工程项目的选择」要从一张排序清单开始，而不是凭空想象。

examples.en: A scoring sheet keeps project selection in capital investment honest across departments.
examples.zh: 一张评分表让各部门的「资本投资中工程项目的选择」保持公道。

collocations: arrange the project selection in capital investment
monitor the project selection in capital investment
repay the project selection in capital investment

words.enDefinition: a profit rate concerning net worth

examples.en: The chain's profit rate of net worth beats the sector average by four points.
examples.zh: 这家连锁的「资本利润率」比同业平均高出4个点。

examples.en: Debt buybacks flattered the profit rate of net worth without adding any profit.
examples.zh: 借债回购美化了「资本利润率」，却没有带来一分钱真实利润。

words.zhGloss: 由库存股票交易所得资本
words.enDefinition: transactions involving capital from treasury stock
acceptedZhAnswers: 由库存股票交易所得资本

examples.en: Accountants credit capital from treasury stock transactions when resale prices exceed cost.
examples.zh: 库存股转售价格高于成本时，差额贷记「由库存股票交易所得资本」。

examples.en: Auditors traced capital from treasury stock transactions back to the original buyback contracts.
examples.zh: 审计师把「由库存股票交易所得资本」追溯到最初的回购合同。

words.enDefinition: the market for short-term, highly liquid debt instruments

examples.en: Corporate treasurers park idle cash in the money market overnight.
examples.zh: 公司资金主管把闲置现金隔夜存放在「货币市场」。

examples.en: Rates in the money market move hours before the official announcement.
examples.zh: 官方宣布之前几个小时，「货币市场」利率早已先行变动。

words.enDefinition: bank borrowings that are due for repayment within one year

examples.en: Short-term bank loans bridge the factory until the autumn order book pays out.
examples.zh: 「短期银行贷款」先撑住工厂，等秋季订单回款接上。

examples.en: Renewing short-term bank loans every quarter keeps the treasurer honest about margins.
examples.zh: 每季度续借「短期银行贷款」，资金主管对利润率就不敢含糊。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning shopping list

examples.en: The grocer extends shopping list credit to regulars who settle on payday.
examples.zh: 杂货店给常客开「采购单贷款」，发薪日再结清。

examples.en: Shopping list credit built customer loyalty long before loyalty cards existed.
examples.zh: 早在会员卡出现之前，「采购单贷款」就在培养顾客的忠诚度。

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy covering goods in transit / shipment risks

examples.en: Check the shipment policy covers overland legs, not just the sea voyage.
examples.zh: 核对「装运保险单」是否覆盖陆运段，而不只是海运。

examples.en: The claim succeeded because the shipment policy named the container explicitly.
examples.zh: 索赔成功，正是因为「装运保险单」明确写明了那只集装箱。

words.enDefinition: an advance for bank

examples.en: The regional bank advance of forty thousand arrived within a week.
examples.zh: 4万的「银行贷款」一周内就放款到位。

examples.en: Bank advance paperwork doubled after the lending rules were tightened.
examples.zh: 放贷新规一出，「银行贷款」的手续翻倍。

collocations: open an account at the bank advance

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with small loan

examples.en: The small loan company approved the tailor's machine purchase in one afternoon.
examples.zh: 「小额贷款公司」一个下午就批下了裁缝的缝纫机购置款。

examples.en: Strict caps now limit what a small loan company may charge.
examples.zh: 如今监管严格限制「小额贷款公司」的收费上限。

collocations: partner with the small loan company
switch to the small loan company

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from shift in

examples.en: A sharp shift in investment moved from offices to warehouses almost overnight.
examples.zh: 「投资转移」几乎一夜之间从写字楼转向了仓库。

examples.en: Economists read the shift in investment as a vote against the tax change.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「投资转移」解读为对税改的一次用脚投票。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from average

examples.en: The underwriter rated the warehouse average risk and priced accordingly.
examples.zh: 核保员把这座仓库定为「平均风险」，照标准费率承保。

examples.en: Most small firms sit at average risk, neither scary nor spotless.
examples.zh: 多数小企业都处于「平均风险」水平，既不吓人也不完美。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from bad

examples.en: Insurers refuse to write bad risk on coastal piers at any price.
examples.zh: 对海滨码头这种「风险大的保险」标的，保险公司出多高价格都不接。

examples.en: The broker shopped the bad risk around until one syndicate blinked.
examples.zh: 经纪人四处推销这份「风险大的保险」，直到一家辛迪加松了口。

words.enDefinition: a quotation for foreign exchange

examples.en: The front page still prints a foreign exchange quotation grid each morning.
examples.zh: 报纸头版每天早上仍印着一张「外汇行情表」。

examples.en: Traders taped the foreign exchange quotation above their desks decades ago.
examples.zh: 几十年前，交易员把「外汇行情表」贴在办公桌上方。

words.enDefinition: loans related to foreign exchange

examples.en: Foreign exchange loans in dollars let the importer match its payables.
examples.zh: 美元「外汇贷款」让进口商的负债与应付账款币种匹配。

examples.en: When the currency slid, foreign exchange loans doubled in local-currency terms.
examples.zh: 本币一贬值，「外汇贷款」按本币计就翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: a market for foreign exchange

examples.en: The foreign exchange market never closes; it just changes cities.
examples.zh: 「外汇市场」永不闭市，只是换一座城市继续交易。

examples.en: Intervention in the foreign exchange market barely dented the trend.
examples.zh: 央行在「外汇市场」的干预，几乎没有撼动这轮趋势。

words.enDefinition: a backed bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: A backed bond tied to the toll revenue sold out in hours.
examples.zh: 这支以过路费收入作抵押的「有抵押债券」，几小时即售罄。

examples.en: Backed bond holders sleep better at night, though their yields run thinner.
examples.zh: 「有抵押债券」持有人睡得更香，代价是收益薄一些。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to back

examples.en: Preferred holders finally collected their back dividend once earnings recovered.
examples.zh: 盈利恢复后，优先股股东终于领到了「拖欠的股利」。

examples.en: Two years of back dividends stack ahead of any common payout.
examples.zh: 两年「拖欠的股利」堆在前头，普通股分红根本轮不上。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for sinking fund

examples.en: Sinking fund expense shows up as a charge before any dividend is discussed.
examples.zh: 先计提「偿债基金费用」，然后才轮得到讨论分红。

examples.en: The board trimmed sinking fund expense to fund the warehouse instead.
examples.zh: 董事会压缩「偿债基金费用」，把钱转投了仓库建设。

words.enDefinition: money received from sinking fund

examples.en: Interest on the sinking fund income account offset a full year of fees.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金收益」账户一年的利息，正好抵掉全年的费用。

examples.en: Trustees reinvest sinking fund income into more of the same bonds.
examples.zh: 受托人把「偿债基金收益」再投入同类债券。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from sinking fund

examples.en: Sinking fund investment rules bar anything riskier than Treasury notes.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金投资」的规定禁止持有比中期国债更风险的品种。

examples.en: The trustee reports all sinking fund investment income every January.
examples.zh: 受托人每年一月汇报全部「偿债基金投资」收益。

words.enDefinition: a bill or security related to a foreign-exchange fund

examples.en: The central bank issued a foreign exchange fund bill to absorb dollar inflows.
examples.zh: 央行发行「外汇资金证券」，以吸收美元流入。

examples.en: Banks tender for the foreign exchange fund bill every Thursday.
examples.zh: 商业银行每周四投标认购「外汇资金证券」。

collocations: issue the foreign exchange fund bill
file the foreign exchange fund bill
review the foreign exchange fund bill

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for foreign exchange

examples.en: The foreign exchange fund grew as trade surpluses piled up.
examples.zh: 贸易顺差不断累积，「外汇基金」随之壮大。

examples.en: Drawing on the foreign exchange fund calmed the panic within a week.
examples.zh: 动用「外汇基金」后，恐慌一周内就平息了。

words.enDefinition: a bank authorised to deal in foreign exchange

examples.en: Only a licensed foreign exchange bank may clear cross-border remittances.
examples.zh: 只有持牌「外汇银行」才能清算跨境汇款。

examples.en: The foreign exchange bank quotes tighter spreads for corporate clients.
examples.zh: 这家「外汇银行」给公司客户的点差更优惠。

collocations: partner with the foreign exchange bank
switch to the foreign exchange bank

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for foreign exchange

examples.en: The subsidiary's foreign exchange budget caps dollar spending at two million a quarter.
examples.zh: 子公司的「外汇预算」规定每季度美元支出上限为200万。

examples.en: Group treasury reviews every foreign exchange budget before the travel season.
examples.zh: 每到差旅旺季，集团资金部都要审一遍各单位的「外汇预算」。

words.enDefinition: a market for foreign exchange free

examples.en: Remittances slipped through the foreign exchange free market when official queues grew.
examples.zh: 官方排队一长，汇款就溜进了「外汇自由市场」。

examples.en: Officials tracked the foreign exchange free market to gauge the true rate.
examples.zh: 官员们盯着「外汇自由市场」，探知真实的汇率。

collocations: secure the foreign exchange free market
visit the foreign exchange free market
lease the foreign exchange free market

words.enDefinition: operations involving foreign currency

examples.en: Hedging costs rose as foreign currency operations expanded into four more currencies.
examples.zh: 「外汇业务」扩展到另外四种货币后，对冲成本随之上升。

examples.en: Every foreign currency operation is logged with its original exchange rate.
examples.zh: 每笔「外汇业务」都按原始汇率登记入账。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with single capital structure

examples.en: A single capital structure company raises money one way: ordinary shares.
examples.zh: 「单一资本结构的公司」只用一种方式融资：普通股。

examples.en: Reformers converted the utility into a single capital structure company to simplify ratings.
examples.zh: 改革者把公用事业公司改组为「单一资本结构的公司」，以简化评级。

collocations: engage the single capital structure company
bank with the single capital structure company
instruct the single capital structure company

words.enDefinition: assets associated with sinking fund

examples.en: Sinking fund assets sit in Treasuries, never in the company's own stock.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金资产」只放国债，绝不买自家股票。

examples.en: Trustees value the sinking fund assets at year-end market prices.
examples.zh: 受托人按年末市价为「偿债基金资产」估值。

words.enDefinition: bonds requiring periodic deposits into a sinking fund for repayment

examples.en: Sinking fund bonds require the issuer to retire a slice each year.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金债券」要求发行人每年赎回一部分。

examples.en: The trustee draws sinking fund bonds by lottery at each annual date.
examples.zh: 每年到期日，受托人抽签赎回部分「偿债基金债券」。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: Under a sight credit, the bank pays the moment documents comply.
examples.zh: 凭「即期信用证」，单证相符的瞬间银行就得付款。

examples.en: The supplier demanded a sight credit instead of sixty-day terms.
examples.zh: 供应商要求开「即期信用证」，不要60天账期。

words.enDefinition: banks involved in associated

examples.en: Transfers between associated banks settle the same day without extra checks.
examples.zh: 「关系银行」之间的转账当天结算，无需额外审核。

examples.en: The group's associated banks share one compliance database across borders.
examples.zh: 集团的各家「关系银行」跨国共用同一套合规数据库。

words.enDefinition: a named commercial bank

examples.en: She opened the firm's account at the first commercial bank on Main Street.
examples.zh: 她在大街上的「第一商业银行」开了公司账户。

examples.en: The first commercial bank in town still requires a wet signature for wires.
examples.zh: 镇上的「第一商业银行」至今汇款还要亲笔签名。

collocations: open an account at the first commercial bank
deal with the first commercial bank

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by stock collateral

examples.en: A stock collateral loan released cash without forcing him to sell a single share.
examples.zh: 一笔「股票担保贷款」让他拿到现金，却不必卖掉一股。

examples.en: When the collateral slid, the stock collateral loan demanded top-up within days.
examples.zh: 抵押股价一下跌，「股票担保贷款」几天内就要求补仓。

words.enDefinition: equity securities and debt securities considered together as investment instruments

examples.en: Grandma split her savings fifty-fifty between stocks and bonds her whole life.
examples.zh: 祖母一辈子的积蓄都对半分投「股票及债券」。

examples.en: Estate auctions now list stocks and bonds alongside the furniture.
examples.zh: 如今的遗产拍卖会上，「股票及债券」也和家具摆在一起列单。

words.zhGloss: 人寿保险股份有限公司
words.enDefinition: companies engaged in stock life insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 人寿保险股份有限公司

examples.en: Stock life insurance companies answer to shareholders, mutuals answer to policyholders.
examples.zh: 「人寿保险股份有限公司」对股东负责，相互制保险公司对保单持有人负责。

examples.en: The largest stock life insurance company listed a century ago and never looked back.
examples.zh: 最大的「人寿保险股份有限公司」百年前上市，从此一发不收。

words.enDefinition: jobbing for stock

examples.en: Stock jobbing moved from shouted quotes in the alley to screens in seconds.
examples.zh: 「证券批发」从小巷里的报价吆喝，几秒间搬到了屏幕上。

examples.en: Old stock jobbing houses faded once the exchange centralised everything.
examples.zh: 交易所集中撮合后，老牌「证券批发」行号逐渐消亡。

words.enDefinition: a stock jobber used in professional practice

examples.en: The stock jobber quoted two-way prices all morning without a wobble.
examples.zh: 这位「证券批发商」整个上午双边报价，稳如磐石。

examples.en: Few remember when a stock jobber stood between buyer and seller on the floor.
examples.zh: 很少有人还记得，当年「证券批发商」站在交易大厅的买卖双方之间。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for stock investment

examples.en: The stock investment trust turned dockworkers' savings into railway shares.
examples.zh: 这家「股票投资信托」把码头工人的积蓄变成了铁路股票。

examples.en: Distributions from the stock investment trust arrive each January and July.
examples.zh: 「股票投资信托」的分红每年一月和七月发放。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in stock insurance

examples.en: A stock insurance corporation can raise capital by issuing more shares.
examples.zh: 「股份保险公司」可以通过增发股票来补充资本。

examples.en: Demutualisation turned the mutual into a stock insurance corporation in 1999.
examples.zh: 1999年股份化改造把这家互助保险公司变成了「股份保险公司」。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with stock insurance

examples.en: As a stock insurance company, it pays taxes that mutuals avoid.
examples.zh: 身为「股份保险公司」，它要缴相互制公司免掉的税。

examples.en: Policyholders hold no votes in a stock insurance company, only claims.
examples.zh: 在「股份保险公司」里，保单持有人没有表决权，只有索赔权。

collocations: open an account at the stock insurance company
deal with the stock insurance company

words.enDefinition: distributions of profits related to stock

examples.en: Stock dividends padded her holdings from four hundred shares to four hundred forty.
examples.zh: 「股票股利」让她的持股从400股增加到440股。

examples.en: Companies prefer stock dividends when cash must stay in the factory.
examples.zh: 现金必须留在工厂时，公司就会改派「股票股利」。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for stock

examples.en: Issuing at ninety created a stock discount on the new shares.
examples.zh: 以90的价格发行新股，形成了「股票折价」。

examples.en: Old charters forbade stock discount entirely, protecting creditors from watered shares.
examples.zh: 旧章程完全禁止「股票折价」，防止债权人被掺水股坑害。

words.enDefinition: financing secured by assets such as receivables, inventory, or equipment
acceptedZhAnswers: 以资产为基础筹措资金

examples.en: Asset-based finance unlocked working capital against invoices and warehouse receipts.
examples.zh: 「资产支持融资」凭发票和仓单盘活了营运资金。

examples.en: Growth of asset-based finance filled the gap banks left behind.
examples.zh: 「资产支持融资」的兴起，填补了银行退出留下的空缺。

words.enDefinition: a book recording stock record

examples.en: The back office reconciles the stock record book against custodian statements nightly.
examples.zh: 后台每晚把「股票记录簿」与托管行对账单核对。

examples.en: An audit of the stock record book caught the duplicate settlement.
examples.zh: 正是查「股票记录簿」时发现了那笔重复交收。

words.enDefinition: an index of stock price

examples.en: The stock price index reclaimed its pre-crisis high after three long years.
examples.zh: 三年苦等之后，「股票价格指数」终于收复危机前高点。

examples.en: Pension funds measure everything against the stock price index of their home market.
examples.zh: 养老基金的一切都以本国「股票价格指数」为标尺。

words.enDefinition: averages of stock price

examples.en: Early newspapers published stock price averages for the rails and little else.
examples.zh: 早期报纸只刊登铁路股的「股票平均价格」，别的几乎不登。

examples.en: Stock price averages smooth out the noise of single-day swings.
examples.zh: 「股票平均价格」能滤掉单日波动的噪音。

words.enDefinition: yield earned from stock

examples.en: The stock yield of four percent beats the bond coupon for once.
examples.zh: 这一次，「股票收益率」4%居然压过了债券票息。

examples.en: Screen for a stock yield above five and you will mostly find utilities.
examples.zh: 按「股票收益率」5%以上筛选，出来的多半是公用事业股。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for stock transfer

examples.en: The stock transfer agent processed forty thousand name changes after the merger.
examples.zh: 并购之后，「股票过户代理人」处理了4万笔过户。

examples.en: Lost certificates go straight to the stock transfer agent for replacement.
examples.zh: 遗失的股票证书直接找「股票过户代理人」补办。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning financing of foreign

examples.en: The financing of foreign trade ran through London acceptance houses a century ago.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前，「对外贸易的资金供应」全靠伦敦的承兑行。

examples.en: Letters of credit remain the backbone of the financing of foreign trade.
examples.zh: 信用证至今仍是「对外贸易的资金供应」的中坚。

words.enDefinition: stock indices published by the Financial Times

examples.en: Pension trustees still benchmark against the financial times stock indices from London.
examples.zh: 养老金受托人至今仍以伦敦的「《金融时报》股票价格指数」为基准。

examples.en: The financial times stock indices date back to editors with slide rules.
examples.zh: 《金融时报》的「股票价格指数」最早由拿着计算尺的编辑们编制。

words.zhGloss: 信誉良好的银行承兑汇票
words.enDefinition: a bank bill of high credit quality, often bank-accepted
acceptedZhAnswers: 信誉良好的银行承兑汇票

examples.en: A fine bank bill from a first-rate acceptance house discounts at par rates.
examples.zh: 一流承兑行开出的「信誉良好的银行承兑汇票」，能按最优利率贴现。

examples.en: Dealers sort the drawer into fine bank bill and trade bill folders.
examples.zh: 交易员把抽屉里的票据分成「信誉良好的银行承兑汇票」与商业票据两类。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from assigned

examples.en: Assigned risk pools guarantee that even the worst drivers find coverage.
examples.zh: 「强制接受的保险业务」池保证再差的司机也买得到保险。

examples.en: The wind farm entered the assigned risk pool after three insurers refused.
examples.zh: 三家保险公司拒保之后，风电场进了「强制接受的保险业务」池。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to floating

examples.en: A tiny floating stock lets a handful of trades move the price.
examples.zh: 「流通股」太少，几笔交易就能把价格打飞。

examples.en: Founders releasing more floating stock improved liquidity without selling control.
examples.zh: 创始人释放更多「流通股」，既改善了流动性，又没让出控制权。

words.enDefinition: a floating rate bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The floating rate bond reset its coupon the day after the hike.
examples.zh: 加息次日，这支「浮动利率债券」的票息就重设了。

examples.en: Conservative buyers chose the floating rate bond to sidestep duration pain.
examples.zh: 稳健买家选「浮动利率债券」，避开久期之痛。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from sound

examples.en: Tuition money belongs in a sound investment, not in the latest fad.
examples.zh: 学费只适合放「稳妥的投资」里，绝不能追风口。

examples.en: Fifteen years on, that sound investment still pays for the clinic's roof.
examples.zh: 十五年过去，那笔「稳妥的投资」还在给诊所屋顶付账。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with departmental

examples.en: The factory holds its departmental capital in machines, not in cash.
examples.zh: 这家工厂的「部门资本」体现在机器上，而不是现金上。

examples.en: Head office charges interest on every unit's departmental capital balance.
examples.zh: 总部对每个部门占用的「部门资本」计收利息。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from sovereign

examples.en: The coup repriced sovereign risk across the whole region overnight.
examples.zh: 政变一夜之间重估了整个地区的「主权风险」。

examples.en: Insurers exclude sovereign risk from standard trade policies for that market.
examples.zh: 针对那个市场，保险公司在标准贸易险中剔除「主权风险」。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the authorized mortgage type

examples.en: The indenture caps authorized mortgage bonds at sixty percent of appraised value.
examples.zh: 契约把「核定抵押债券（公司债）」限制在评估价值的60%以内。

examples.en: Directors approved issuing more authorized mortgage bonds against the new plant.
examples.zh: 董事会批准以新厂房作押增发「核定抵押债券（公司债）」。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from authorized

examples.en: Trust deeds list every authorized investment the fund may touch.
examples.zh: 信托契据列明基金可触及的每一类「经核准的投资」。

examples.en: Anything outside authorized investment classes needs a member vote first.
examples.zh: 「经核准的投资」类别之外的一切，都须先经成员表决。

words.enDefinition: a bank authorised to conduct foreign-exchange business

examples.en: Only an authorized foreign exchange bank may settle import letters of credit.
examples.zh: 只有「授权的外汇银行」才能办理进口信用证结算。

examples.en: Importers opened accounts at an authorized foreign exchange bank before applying for quota.
examples.zh: 申请配额之前，进口商得先在「授权的外汇银行」开户。

collocations: partner with the authorized foreign exchange bank
switch to the authorized foreign exchange bank
evaluate the authorized foreign exchange bank

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for social insurance trust

examples.en: Payroll contributions flow into social insurance trust funds earmarked for pensions and care.
examples.zh: 工资代扣款流入「社会保险信托基金」，专用于养老与照护。

examples.en: An aging population squeezes social insurance trust funds from both ends.
examples.zh: 人口老龄化从两头挤压「社会保险信托基金」。

collocations: arrange the social insurance trust funds
monitor the social insurance trust funds
repay the social insurance trust funds

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from autonomous

examples.en: Government labs drive autonomous investment that ignores quarterly profit math.
examples.zh: 政府实验室推动的是「自主投资」，完全不理会季度利润账。

examples.en: Autonomous investment in grid upgrades proceeded through three recessions untouched.
examples.zh: 电网升级的「自主投资」穿越三次衰退，纹丝不动。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from fixed capital

examples.en: Fixed capital investment in new ovens doubled the bakery's daily output.
examples.zh: 新烤炉的「固定资本投资」让面包房日产量翻倍。

examples.en: Tax credits revived fixed capital investment after two flat years.
examples.zh: 税收抵免让停滞两年的「固定资本投资」重新启动。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from speculative

examples.en: Speculative investment in the coin craze evaporated within a single winter.
examples.zh: 炒币热潮里的「投机投资」，一个冬天就蒸发殆尽。

examples.en: Keep speculative investment under five percent of anything you cannot afford to lose.
examples.zh: 「投机投资」控制在5%以内，只放你亏得起的钱。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for fixed investment

examples.en: The fixed investment trust holds one list of bonds and never trades.
examples.zh: 这家「固定投资信托公司」只持有一份固定的债券清单，从不换仓。

examples.en: Fees at a fixed investment trust run lower precisely because it never trades.
examples.zh: 「固定投资信托公司」从不交易，费率自然更低。

words.enDefinition: a specialised safe-deposit facility or vault service

examples.en: Museums rent special safe-deposit vaults for works too fragile to exhibit.
examples.zh: 博物馆租用「特种保险仓库」，存放脆弱到无法展出的藏品。

examples.en: Access to the special safe-deposit requires two curators and one registrar.
examples.zh: 进入「特种保险仓库」需要两位策展人和一位登记员同时到场。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for special revenue

examples.en: Parking fines feed the special revenue fund earmarked for road repairs.
examples.zh: 停车罚单收入注入「特种收入基金」，专款用于道路维修。

examples.en: Auditors check that the special revenue fund never subsidizes the general budget.
examples.zh: 审计确认「特种收入基金」绝不补贴一般预算。

words.enDefinition: a bank specialising in foreign-exchange operations

examples.en: Importers of machinery bank with the specialized foreign exchange bank downtown.
examples.zh: 机械设备进口商都把账户开在城里的「外汇专业银行」。

examples.en: The specialized foreign exchange bank quotes forward contracts out to three years.
examples.zh: 这家「外汇专业银行」的远期合约可以报到三年。

collocations: open an account at the specialized foreign exchange bank
deal with the specialized foreign exchange bank
audit the specialized foreign exchange bank

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to revenue from

examples.en: Revenue from investments covered the theater's payroll for the first time.
examples.zh: 「投资收入」头一回覆盖了剧院的工资开支。

examples.en: Revenue from investments rises and falls with dividends, not with ticket sales.
examples.zh: 「投资收入」随股息起伏，与票房无关。

words.enDefinition: a revenue bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The revenue bond repays itself from bridge tolls, not from taxes.
examples.zh: 「收益债券」靠过桥费还本付息，不动用税收。

examples.en: Water districts floated a revenue bond to expand the treatment plant.
examples.zh: 供水区发行「收益债券」扩建净水厂。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for revenue

examples.en: All tax receipts flow into revenue funds before any appropriation.
examples.zh: 全部税收先进「收入基金」，再谈拨款。

examples.en: Revenue funds are audited separately from capital accounts every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「收入基金」与资本账户分开审计。

words.enDefinition: pricing for return-on-investment

examples.en: Return-on-investment pricing sets the list price so the plant clears its target return.
examples.zh: 「按投资利润率核算」定价，让厂子刚好达成目标回报。

examples.en: Competitors undercut return-on-investment pricing within a season, forcing a rethink.
examples.zh: 竞争者一个季度就击穿了「按投资利润率核算」的定价，公司只好重新思考。

words.enDefinition: return arranged on capital employed terms

examples.en: Return on capital employed of fifteen percent marks this as a genuinely good business.
examples.zh: 「运用资本收益率」达到15%，说明这确实是门好生意。

examples.en: Stripping idle land out lifts the return on capital employed instantly.
examples.zh: 剔除闲置土地后，「运用资本收益率」立刻上抬。

collocations: calculate the return on capital employed
compare the return on capital employed
interpret the return on capital employed

words.enDefinition: a capital metric or concept concerning return on investment

examples.en: Venture partners argue about return on investment capital until the numbers arrive.
examples.zh: 数字没出来之前，合伙人关于「投资利润」的争论停不下来。

examples.en: A return on investment capital below the fund's hurdle triggers the clawback.
examples.zh: 「投资利润」一旦低于基金门槛，回拨条款就会启动。

collocations: calculate the return on investment capital
compare the return on investment capital
interpret the return on investment capital

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for general management

examples.en: The general management trust leaves day-to-day calls to the bank's committee.
examples.zh: 「一般管理信托投资」的日常操作交给银行的委员会。

examples.en: Beneficiaries may challenge the general management trust only for evident neglect.
examples.zh: 只有明显失职时，受益人才能对「一般管理信托投资」提出异议。

words.zhGloss: 可撤销银行未确认(未保兑)的信用状
words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)
acceptedZhAnswers: 可撤销银行未确认(未保兑)的信用状

examples.en: A revocable unconfirmed banker's credit protects the buyer, never the exporter.
examples.zh: 「可撤销银行未确认（未保兑）的信用状」保护的是买方，绝不是出口商。

examples.en: The seller renegotiated once the revocable unconfirmed banker's credit arrived.
examples.zh: 看到「可撤销银行未确认（未保兑）的信用状」，卖方立刻要求重新谈条款。

collocations: arrange the revocable unconfirmed banker's credit
monitor the revocable unconfirmed banker's credit
repay the revocable unconfirmed banker's credit

words.enDefinition: a consolidation of shares that reduces the number outstanding

examples.en: The reverse stock split turned ten old shares into one new one.
examples.zh: 这次「股票合并」把十股旧股换成一股新股。

examples.en: Companies execute a reverse stock split to stay above the exchange's price floor.
examples.zh: 公司做「股票合并」，是为了股价不跌破交易所的下限。

words.enDefinition: banking related to retail

examples.en: Retail banking lives on small deposits, cards, and Saturday queues.
examples.zh: 「零售银行业务」靠小额存款、银行卡和周六的排队撑着。

examples.en: Apps ate the branch network, but retail banking still needs human moments.
examples.zh: App吃掉了网点，但「零售银行业务」仍少不了与人打交道的时候。

words.enDefinition: a bank in the position of debtor on an interbank claim

examples.en: In the interbank clearing, every debtor bank settles before the close.
examples.zh: 同业清算中，每家「债务银行」必须在收市前结清欠款。

examples.en: A debtor bank that misses the deadline borrows from the central facility.
examples.zh: 错过截止时间的「债务银行」，只能向中央机制拆借。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for general bonded-debt

examples.en: Debt service flows through the general bonded-debt fund, not the operating budget.
examples.zh: 还本付息走「普通债券债务基金」，不占运营预算。

examples.en: Voters approved a general bonded-debt fund for the courthouse renovation.
examples.zh: 选民批准设立「普通债券债务基金」用于法院翻修。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for rotary

examples.en: Repayments recycle straight back into the rotary fund for the next loan.
examples.zh: 还回的钱直接回到「周转基金」，贷给下一家。

examples.en: The rotary fund has turned over four times since it launched.
examples.zh: 「周转基金」设立以来已经滚动周转了四次。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with declared

examples.en: Declared capital of one million bounds what directors may pay out.
examples.zh: 「申报资本」为100万，约束着董事会的分红上限。

examples.en: The registry lists declared capital, never the true funds subscribed.
examples.zh: 登记处只记录「申报资本」，实际认缴了多少它不管。

words.enDefinition: a deposit required when discounting a bill

examples.en: The bank holds a bill discount deposit until the discounted bill matures.
examples.zh: 银行先收「票据贴现押金（保证金）」，直到贴现票据到期。

examples.en: Bill discount deposit rules eased for small traders this spring.
examples.zh: 今春起，小商户的「票据贴现押金（保证金）」要求放宽了。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of risk-return

examples.en: Our risk-return analysis killed the deal before it reached the board.
examples.zh: 「风险收益分析」在提交董事会之前就毙掉了这笔交易。

examples.en: Every bid we send out carries a one-page risk-return analysis.
examples.zh: 我们发出的每份标书都附一页「风险收益分析」。

words.enDefinition: a market for bill

examples.en: The bill market deepens every autumn as importers fund seasonal stock.
examples.zh: 每年秋天进口商备货，「汇票市场」随之升温。

examples.en: Rates in the bill market move before the policy announcement.
examples.zh: 政策宣布之前，「汇票市场」的利率就已经先动了。

collocations: clear goods through the bill market

words.enDefinition: capital associated with risk

examples.en: Risk capital is the only money that belongs in a seed round.
examples.zh: 种子轮里放的钱，只能是「风险资本」。

examples.en: A century ago, risk capital meant clipper ships and spice runs.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前，「风险资本」指的是快帆船和香料航线。

words.enDefinition: a pool of risk capital

examples.en: Four governments contributed to a risk capital pool for border-region startups.
examples.zh: 四国政府共同出资设立「风险资本合营」，扶持边境地区初创企业。

examples.en: Losses in the risk capital pool are shared, never chased individually.
examples.zh: 「风险资本合营」的亏损由各方分摊，谁也不单独追偿。

words.enDefinition: a factor affecting risk discount

examples.en: The risk discount factor trims each cash flow by its uncertainty.
examples.zh: 「风险折现因子」按不确定性程度削减每一笔现金流。

examples.en: Actuaries recalibrated the risk discount factor after two catastrophic years.
examples.zh: 经历两个灾难年份后，精算师重新校准了「风险折现因子」。

words.enDefinition: transit of risk in

examples.en: Risk in transit shifts to the buyer the moment goods cross the rail.
examples.zh: 货物越过船舷的那一刻，「运输途中的风险」就转移给了买方。

examples.en: Marine insurance exists precisely because risk in transit is unavoidable.
examples.zh: 海上保险的存在，正是因为「运输途中的风险」无法避免。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from risk

examples.en: Her first risk investment in a robotics lab tripled within five years.
examples.zh: 她第一笔投向机器人实验室的「风险投资」，五年翻了三倍。

examples.en: Universities nurture risk investment through campus incubators and patient alumni money.
examples.zh: 大学靠校内孵化器和耐心的校友资金培育「风险投资」。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for renewal

examples.en: Every machine sale feeds the renewal fund for the next replacement.
examples.zh: 每台设备的销售提成存入「更新基金」，留给下一次换新。

examples.en: The renewal fund bought the new boiler without any borrowing.
examples.zh: 「更新基金」直接买下了新锅炉，一分钱没借。

words.enDefinition: the amount of capital registered with the company registry

examples.en: Registered capital of two million appears on every business license.
examples.zh: 每张营业执照上都写着200万的「注册资本」。

examples.en: Suppliers check registered capital before extending any meaningful credit line.
examples.zh: 供应商在放账之前，都要先查对方的「注册资本」。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to regular

examples.en: The regular dividend of one dollar has held through four downturns.
examples.zh: 每股1美元的「固定股利」，穿越了四次衰退期。

examples.en: Special payouts can never substitute for a reliable regular dividend.
examples.zh: 特殊派息永远替代不了稳定的「固定股利」。

words.zhGloss: 偿还旧债券的(新债券)发行
words.enDefinition: an issue of refunding
acceptedZhAnswers: 偿还旧债券的(新债券)发行

examples.en: The refunding issue swapped the old nine-percent paper for five-and-a-half-percent notes.
examples.zh: 这次「偿还旧债券的（新债券）发行」，用5.5%的新票换掉了9%的旧票。

examples.en: Councilmen debated the refunding issue for two nights before approving it.
examples.zh: 议员们为「偿还旧债券的（新债券）发行」辩论了两个晚上才放行。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to bond

examples.en: Bond interest arrives twice a year like clockwork, whatever the news says.
examples.zh: 「债券利息」像钟表一样半年一次到账，新闻再乱也不影响。

examples.en: Rising rates squeeze bond interest budgets in every municipality this year.
examples.zh: 利率上行，今年各地财政的「债券利息」预算都被压紧。

words.enDefinition: legal contracts governing bond issues

examples.en: Bond indentures spell out covenants that lawyers fight over for decades.
examples.zh: 「债券发行契约」写明的各项约定，能让律师吵上几十年。

examples.en: The trustee reads the bond indentures before releasing any collateral.
examples.zh: 放行任何抵押品之前，受托人都要先读一遍「债券发行契约」。

words.enDefinition: a market for bond flotation

examples.en: The bond flotation market reopened the week the ratings stabilized.
examples.zh: 评级企稳的那一周，「债券发行市场」重新开闸。

examples.en: Smaller issuers crowd into the bond flotation market every January.
examples.zh: 每年一月，小发行人挤满了「债券发行市场」。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for bond

examples.en: Bond expense of two hundred thousand covered legal, printing, and underwriting.
examples.zh: 20万的「债券发行费」覆盖了律师、印刷和承销。

examples.en: Amortize bond expense over the life of the issue, not upfront.
examples.zh: 「债券发行费」要按存续期摊销，不能一次入账。

words.enDefinition: distributions of profits related to bond

examples.en: Bond dividends paid holders in notes of the parent company.
examples.zh: 「公司债股利」以母公司票据的形式支付给持有人。

examples.en: Regulators questioned whether bond dividends disguised a failing cash position.
examples.zh: 监管质疑「公司债股利」是否掩盖了现金枯竭的真相。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for bond

examples.en: The bond discount of eight points reflected the credit scare.
examples.zh: 8个点的「债券折价」反映的是信用恐慌。

examples.en: Issue at ninety and the bond discount accrues back to par over twenty years.
examples.zh: 以90的价格发行，「债券折价」将在二十年内摊回面值。

words.enDefinition: the bank authorised to reimburse another bank under an LC

examples.en: The reimbursing bank wires the proceeds as soon as documents match.
examples.zh: 单证一相符，「偿付银行」立即汇出款项。

examples.en: Charges of the reimbursing bank fall on whoever the credit names.
examples.zh: 「偿付银行」的费用由信用证指定的一方承担。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to bogus

examples.en: Paying a bogus dividend out of capital hid the losses for one audit cycle.
examples.zh: 用资本冒充利润发放「虚假股利」，把亏损掩盖了一个审计周期。

examples.en: Directors face personal liability for any bogus dividend they approve.
examples.zh: 批准「虚假股利」的董事要承担个人责任。

words.zhGloss: 发行银行存于外国银行的黄金
words.enDefinition: gold deposited by an issuing bank with a foreign bank
acceptedZhAnswers: 发行银行存于外国银行的黄金

examples.en: The central bank's gold deposit in Zurich backs the currency board.
examples.zh: 央行「发行银行存于外国银行的黄金」存放在苏黎世，支撑着货币局制度。

examples.en: Auditors fly out yearly to count the gold deposit bars by bar.
examples.zh: 审计人员每年飞赴现场，逐块清点「发行银行存于外国银行的黄金」。

words.enDefinition: money received from reinvested

examples.en: Reinvested income doubled the endowment while the payout stayed frozen.
examples.zh: 支出冻结期间，「再投资收益」让捐赠基金翻了一番。

examples.en: Tax deferral only pays off when reinvested income actually compounds.
examples.zh: 只有「再投资收益」真正复利起来，递延纳税才有意义。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from reinvested

examples.en: Reinvested profit built the second factory without a single bank visit.
examples.zh: 靠「再投资利润」，第二座工厂拔地而起，银行门都没进。

examples.en: Owners split over spending the reinvested profit or finally paying themselves.
examples.zh: 股东为「再投资利润」的去向吵翻了：继续投，还是给自己分红？

words.enDefinition: rates applied to regulated interest

examples.en: Regulated interest rates on small deposits barely moved for a decade.
examples.zh: 小额存款的「规定利率」十年几乎纹丝不动。

examples.en: Deregulation replaced regulated interest rates with whatever the market would bear.
examples.zh: 摆脱管制后，「规定利率」让位于市场能承受的任何水平。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with regulate

examples.en: The commission can regulate capital levels of every licensed insurer.
examples.zh: 委员会负责核定每家持牌保险公司的「管理资本」水平。

examples.en: New rules regulate capital far more tightly after the near-collapse.
examples.zh: 濒临倒闭事件后，新规对「管理资本」的管控严格得多。

words.enDefinition: a central or reserve bank that holds reserves and issues currency policy

examples.en: The reserve bank set the rediscount window rate at four percent.
examples.zh: 「储备银行」把再贴现窗口利率定在4%。

examples.en: Regional branches of the reserve bank survey manufacturers every month.
examples.zh: 「储备银行」的各地分行每月对制造商做调查。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for reserve for pension

examples.en: The reserve for pension fund obligations grew with every hire.
examples.zh: 每招一名员工，「恤养基金准备」就增厚一分。

examples.en: Actuaries test the reserve for pension fund adequacy every three years.
examples.zh: 精算师每三年检验一次「恤养基金准备」是否充足。

collocations: arrange the reserve for pension fund
monitor the reserve for pension fund
repay the reserve for pension fund

words.enDefinition: high-grade bonds, especially UK government securities, with very low default risk

examples.en: Gilt-edged securities barely yield three percent, but they never wake you at night.
examples.zh: 「金边证券」收益率不到3%，但从不会让你半夜惊醒。

examples.en: Victorian widows lived comfortably on the coupons of gilt-edged securities.
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代的寡妇们靠「金边证券」的息票过上体面日子。

words.enDefinition: a surety or insurance bond covering obligations or risks related to debenture mortgage

examples.en: The debenture mortgage bond carries the plant as security plus a bank guarantee.
examples.zh: 这支「信用担保债券」以厂房作押，另有银行担保加持。

examples.en: Rating agencies treat the debenture mortgage bond as investment grade.
examples.zh: 评级机构把这支「信用担保债券」评为投资级。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by debenture

examples.en: The debenture loan runs ten years with interest paid twice yearly.
examples.zh: 这笔「债券贷款」期限十年，每半年付息一次。

examples.en: Refinancing replaced the bank overdraft with a cheaper debenture loan.
examples.zh: 借新还旧，用更便宜的「债券贷款」换掉了银行透支。

words.enDefinition: the conversion or marketplace related to security

examples.en: The security exchange suspended trading the morning the news broke.
examples.zh: 消息传出当天上午，「证券交易所」宣布暂停交易。

examples.en: Listing rules at the security exchange require three years of audited accounts.
examples.zh: 「证券交易所」的上市规则要求三年经审计的账目。

collocations: clear goods through the security exchange

words.enDefinition: the study and valuation of securities to guide investment decisions

examples.en: Security analysis starts with the balance sheet, not with the story.
examples.zh: 「证券分析」从资产负债表开始，而不是从故事开始。

examples.en: Graham and Dodd wrote the book that defined security analysis.
examples.zh: 格雷厄姆和多德写下了定义「证券分析」的那本经典。

words.enDefinition: companies engaged in securities substitution

examples.en: Securities substitution companies swap collateral daily to keep pools compliant.
examples.zh: 「证券替换公司」每天置换抵押品，保证资产池合规。

examples.en: Fees at securities substitution companies run by the basis point.
examples.zh: 「证券替换公司」的收费按基点计算。

words.enDefinition: a market for securities

examples.en: The securities market reopened two hours late after the outage.
examples.zh: 系统故障后，「证券市场」推迟两小时开盘。

examples.en: Foreign participation in the securities market doubled within two years.
examples.zh: 两年之内，外资在「证券市场」的参与度翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for securities investment

examples.en: The securities investment trust spreads small savings across forty listed names.
examples.zh: 这只「证券投资信托」把小额积蓄分散到40只上市股票上。

examples.en: Unit prices of the securities investment trust publish every evening.
examples.zh: 「证券投资信托」的净值每晚公布。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with securities finance

examples.en: The securities finance company lends shares to traders who short the market.
examples.zh: 「证券金融公司」向做空市场的交易者出借股票。

examples.en: Margin calls route through the securities finance company before brokers act.
examples.zh: 追保通知先经过「证券金融公司」，然后券商才动手。

collocations: bank with the securities finance company

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with securities

examples.en: Every securities company in town hired fresh graduates that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，城里每家「证券公司」都在批量招应届生。

examples.en: The securities company sponsors research reports, not just order execution.
examples.zh: 这家「证券公司」不只做交易执行，还养着研究团队。

words.enDefinition: a securities and investment used in professional practice

examples.en: The division covers both securities and investment advisory services under one license.
examples.zh: 这张牌照同时覆盖「证券及投资」顾问两类服务。

examples.en: The group reports securities and investment as a single business line.
examples.zh: 集团把「证券及投资」合并为一条业务线列报。

words.enDefinition: a securities-market regulator titled Securities and Exchange Commission (e.g. the U.S. SEC)

examples.en: The securities and exchange commission froze withdrawals pending the probe.
examples.zh: 调查期间，「证券交易委员会」冻结了资金提取。

examples.en: Quarterly filings to the securities and exchange commission run six hundred pages.
examples.zh: 提交「证券交易委员会」的季报厚达六百页。

words.enDefinition: securities that has been issued

examples.en: Securities issued under the old charter carried handwritten serial numbers.
examples.zh: 旧章程下「已发行的证券」都带着手写编号。

examples.en: The prospectus lists total securities issued and the amount still outstanding.
examples.zh: 招募说明书列明「已发行的证券」总额及尚在外流通的部分。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by security

examples.en: A security loan against his portfolio funded the boat without selling anything.
examples.zh: 以持仓作押的「证券贷款」买下了那条船，一股没卖。

examples.en: Interest on the security loan floats with the overnight rate.
examples.zh: 「证券贷款」的利息随隔夜利率浮动。

words.enDefinition: a market for security

examples.en: The security market in Mumbai lists over a thousand listed names.
examples.zh: 孟买的「证券市场」上市公司超过一千家。

examples.en: Trading halts in the security market last fifteen minutes, maximum.
examples.zh: 「证券市场」的临时停牌最长十五分钟。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to barometer

examples.en: Traders treat the chip giant as a barometer stock for the whole cycle.
examples.zh: 交易员把这家芯片巨头当作反映整个周期的「指标股」。

examples.en: When the barometer stock sneezes, the rest of the index catches cold.
examples.zh: 「指标股」一打喷嚏，整个指数都要跟着感冒。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to free market

examples.en: The free market rate for dollars ran ten percent above the official one.
examples.zh: 美元的「自由市场汇率」比官方价高出10%。

examples.en: Remitters ignored the official window and used the free market rate.
examples.zh: 汇款人绕开官方窗口，直接用「自由市场汇率」。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for self-insurance

examples.en: The group set up a self-insurance fund instead of renewing external policies.
examples.zh: 集团停购外部保单，自设「自办（行）保险基金」。

examples.en: Contributions to the self-insurance fund follow each unit's claims history.
examples.zh: 各单位按理赔记录向「自办（行）保险基金」缴款。

words.enDefinition: a line of basic credit

examples.en: The basic credit line covers payroll even in the worst month.
examples.zh: 就算最糟的月份，「基本贷款限额」也足以覆盖工资支出。

examples.en: Anything beyond the basic credit line needs a board signature.
examples.zh: 超出「基本贷款限额」的用款，都需要董事会签字。

words.enDefinition: a deficit-covering bond; a debt security with the stated features
acceptedZhAnswers: 赤字债券弥补支绌债券

examples.en: The treasury floated a deficit-covering bond to plug the emergency shortfall.
examples.zh: 财政部发行「弥补赤字债券」，堵上紧急资金缺口。

examples.en: Deficit-covering bond proceeds may only fund the items listed in the annex.
examples.zh: 「弥补赤字债券」的募集资金只能用于附件所列项目。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the bank restricted type

examples.en: Bank restricted bonds trade only among institutions on the approved list.
examples.zh: 「银行限制债券」只在名单内机构之间流转。

examples.en: Retail investors cannot touch bank restricted bonds, whatever the yield offers.
examples.zh: 收益再诱人，散户也碰不到「银行限制债券」。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with bank holding

examples.en: The bank holding company owns eleven subsidiaries across four states.
examples.zh: 这家「银行持股公司」在四个州拥有11家子公司。

examples.en: Regulators consolidated supervision of the bank holding company after the merger.
examples.zh: 并购之后，监管把「银行持股公司」纳入统一监管。

collocations: open an account at the bank holding company
deal with the bank holding company

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by bank term

examples.en: A five-year bank term loan replaced the revolving credit entirely.
examples.zh: 一笔5年期「银行定期贷款」完全取代了循环授信。

examples.en: Covenants in the bank term loan forbid dividends until leverage falls.
examples.zh: 「银行定期贷款」约定杠杆降下来之前不得分红。

words.enDefinition: a reference concerning bank

examples.en: The landlord asked for a bank reference before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 房东签约前索要了一份「银行资信证明」。

examples.en: A bank reference letter from her old branch opened every door.
examples.zh: 老开户行出具的一封「银行资信证明」，让她处处畅通。

collocations: open an account at the bank reference

words.enDefinition: a paper concerning bank

examples.en: Collectors distinguish bank paper from treasury notes by the engraved signatures.
examples.zh: 收藏家靠雕版签名区分「银行纸币」与财政券。

examples.en: Counterfeit bank paper fooled the teller for exactly one afternoon.
examples.zh: 一张假「银行纸币」骗过了柜员，就一个下午的工夫。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for bank

examples.en: Bank charges on the escrow account ate four hundred dollars a year.
examples.zh: 托管账户的「银行手续费」一年吞掉400美元。

examples.en: We negotiated bank charges down when the deposit balances doubled.
examples.zh: 存款翻倍之后，我们把「银行手续费」谈了下来。

words.enDefinition: the conversion or marketplace related to share-for-share

examples.en: The merger closed as a share-for-share exchange, no cash changing hands.
examples.zh: 并购以「股票换股票」完成，一分现金都没动。

examples.en: Tax authorities treat a share-for-share exchange as a deferral, not a sale.
examples.zh: 税务机关把「股票换股票」视为递延，而非出售。

words.enDefinition: an acceptance for bank

examples.en: Sellers trust a bank acceptance because the bank itself owes the money.
examples.zh: 卖方信任「银行承兑」，因为欠钱的是银行自己。

examples.en: The bank acceptance traded near par until the issuing bank wobbled.
examples.zh: 开证行一出事，这张「银行承兑」的价格就跌破了面值附近。

words.enDefinition: a card used for bank credit

examples.en: Her first bank credit card carried a modest three-hundred-dollar limit.
examples.zh: 她的第一张「银行信用卡」额度只有区区300美元。

examples.en: The bank credit card doubles as the transit pass downtown.
examples.zh: 在市中心，「银行信用卡」还能当公交卡刷。

words.enDefinition: safekeeping arrangements for bank

examples.en: Fund shares sit under bank custody until the audit closes.
examples.zh: 审计结束前，基金份额一直处于「银行托管」之下。

examples.en: Bank custody fees run a few basis points a year.
