examples.zh: 「银行托管」费一年只收几个基点。

words.enDefinition: a debenture for bank

examples.en: The bank debenture matures in 2031 and pays coupons quarterly.
examples.zh: 这支「银行债券」2031年到期，按季付息。

examples.en: Insurance funds bought the bank debenture issue within a morning.
examples.zh: 「银行债券」发行当天上午就被保险资金抢完。

collocations: open an account at the bank debenture

words.enDefinition: a draft drawn by or on a bank

examples.en: Pay the embassy fee with a bank draft, not a personal check.
examples.zh: 大使馆的费用要用「银行汇票」缴，别用个人支票。

examples.en: The bank draft cleared the same day it was drawn.
examples.zh: 这张「银行汇票」开票当天就完成了清算。

words.enDefinition: a bank concerning commerce

examples.en: The bank of commerce on the corner financed half the market stalls.
examples.zh: 街角的「商业银行」资助了市场里一半的摊位。

examples.en: Our grandparents banked at the bank of commerce for forty years.
examples.zh: 祖父母在「商业银行」存了四十年的钱。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with bank monopoly

examples.en: The textbook chapter traces bank monopoly capital through the railway era.
examples.zh: 教材那一章梳理了铁路时代「银行垄断资本」的形成。

examples.en: Antitrust hearings examined how bank monopoly capital squeezed smaller lenders out.
examples.zh: 反垄断听证会追问「银行垄断资本」如何挤垮小放贷机构。

words.enDefinition: money held as bank deposits and transferable by cheque or electronic transfer

examples.en: Bank money moves by wire now; hardly anyone touches notes.
examples.zh: 如今「存款货币」靠电汇流转，几乎没人碰钞票。

examples.en: Most of what we call money is actually bank money, entries in ledgers.
examples.zh: 我们所说的货币，大部分其实是「银行货币」——账本上的数字。

words.enDefinition: loans related to bank

examples.en: Bank loans to small farms carry seasonal grace periods by default.
examples.zh: 给小农户的「银行贷款」默认带有季节性宽限期。

examples.en: Renewable-energy developers jostle for bank loans priced at three percent.
examples.zh: 新能源开发商挤破头抢3%利率的「银行贷款」。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to bank

examples.en: Bank interest on the savings account barely covers a coffee a month.
examples.zh: 储蓄账户的「银行利息」一个月只够买杯咖啡。

examples.en: Retirees moved balances chasing bank interest that beat the inflation rate.
examples.zh: 为了跑赢通胀的「银行利息」，退休族纷纷搬存款。

words.enDefinition: a market for free exchange

examples.en: The free exchange market set its own price within an hour of the news.
examples.zh: 消息一出，「自由外汇市场」一小时内就给出了自己的价格。

examples.en: Bureaucrats pretend that the free exchange market simply does not exist.
examples.zh: 官员们假装「自由外汇市场」根本不存在。

words.enDefinition: an acceptance for banker's

examples.en: The exporter discounted the banker's acceptance the day it arrived.
examples.zh: 「银行承兑」一到手，出口商当天就贴现了。

examples.en: Trade runs on the banker's acceptance wherever trust runs thin.
examples.zh: 哪里信任稀缺，哪里的贸易就靠「银行承兑」运转。

words.enDefinition: a banker and customer used in professional practice

examples.en: The banking code spells out the banker and customer relationship in plain terms.
examples.zh: 银行业守则以平实语言界定了「银行与客户关系」。

examples.en: Court cases still cite century-old rules on banker and customer duties.
examples.zh: 法院判例至今还在引用百年前的「银行与客户关系」规则。

words.enDefinition: a project for bankable

examples.en: With the feasibility study done, the wind farm became a bankable project.
examples.zh: 可行性研究一完成，风电场就成了「可获银行融资的项目」。

examples.en: Lenders rejected the mine as anything but a marginal bankable project.
examples.zh: 放贷方认为那座矿最多算勉强「可获银行融资的项目」。

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing bank-rate

examples.en: The bank-rate policy of cheap money lasted through the whole reconstruction decade.
examples.zh: 整个重建十年，「银行利率政策」都维持着廉价资金。

examples.en: Critics blamed the bank-rate policy for fueling the land boom.
examples.zh: 批评者指责「银行利率政策」助长了地产狂热。

words.enDefinition: the bank's buying rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Tourists receive the bank's buying rate, never the mid-market figure.
examples.zh: 游客拿到的是「银行购进汇率」，从来不是中间价。

examples.en: The spread between the bank's buying rate and selling rate is the profit.
examples.zh: 「银行购进汇率」与卖出价之间的价差，就是银行的利润。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for banker's

examples.en: House purchases in the old days settled by banker's payment, never cash.
examples.zh: 老一辈买房交割全靠「银行间支付」，绝不碰现金。

examples.en: The escrow released only upon a verified banker's payment record.
examples.zh: 托管金只有见到核验过的「银行间支付」凭证才放款。

words.zhGloss: 银行定期付款指示；银行委托书
words.enDefinition: an instruction to a bank to make regular payments (standing order)
acceptedZhAnswers: 银行定期付款指示；银行委托书

examples.en: Set up a banker's order and the rent pays itself every month.
examples.zh: 办好「银行定期付款指示」，房租每月自动扣缴。

examples.en: Cancel the banker's order in writing before the account closes.
examples.zh: 销户前记得书面撤销「银行定期付款指示」。

words.enDefinition: a market for banker's acceptance

examples.en: Rates in the banker's acceptance market firmed ahead of the shipping season.
examples.zh: 航运旺季前，「银行承兑市场」的利率悄悄走高。

examples.en: The banker's acceptance market thinned out once trade volumes collapsed.
examples.zh: 贸易量崩塌后，「银行承兑市场」迅速变薄。

words.enDefinition: a bank that provides services primarily to other banks

examples.en: The central bank is the banker's bank, lending only to other banks.
examples.zh: 央行是「银行的银行」，只对其他银行放贷。

examples.en: Clearing between cities settles through the banker's bank every night.
examples.zh: 城市之间的清算每晚都通过「银行的银行」完成。

collocations: open an account at the banker's bank

words.enDefinition: fidelity/crime insurance protecting a bank against employee dishonesty, forgery, and related losses

examples.en: The branch robbery tested the banker's blanket bond for the first time in decades.
examples.zh: 这次网点抢劫，是「银行综合保单」几十年来头一次出险。

examples.en: Employee fraud falls squarely under the banker's blanket bond policy.
examples.zh: 员工舞弊正是「银行综合保单」承保的范围。

words.enDefinition: the banker's buying rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Compare the banker's buying rate across three counters before changing money.
examples.zh: 换钱之前，先比较三个柜台的「银行购买汇率」。

examples.en: The banker's buying rate for travelers' checks runs a point lower.
examples.zh: 旅行支票的「银行购买汇率」要再低一个点。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The confirming bank claims under the banker's reimbursement credit, not the importer.
examples.zh: 保兑行向「银行偿付信用证」索偿，而不是找进口商。

examples.en: Delays at the banker's reimbursement credit stage stretch payment by weeks.
examples.zh: 「银行偿付信用证」环节一拖延，付款就要多等几个星期。

words.enDefinition: power over banking

examples.en: Every new deposit multiplies the banking power of the whole system.
examples.zh: 每一笔新存款都在放大整个体系的「贷出能力」。

examples.en: Reserve cuts released banking power that lent itself into a property boom.
examples.zh: 降准释放的「贷出能力」，最终都涌进了地产热潮。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with banking

examples.en: Banking capital absorbs the first losses when loans go sour.
examples.zh: 贷款变坏时，「银行资本」首当其冲吸收损失。

examples.en: New rules require banking capital to equal eight percent of risk-weighted assets.
examples.zh: 新规要求「银行资本」不低于风险加权资产的8%。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the serial type

examples.en: Serial bonds retire a slice every year, sparing the maturity wall.
examples.zh: 「分批还本债券」每年赎回一部分，避免到期墙。

examples.en: School districts favor serial bonds because budgets stretch across years.
examples.zh: 学区偏爱「分批还本债券」，还款正好摊进多年预算。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by funding

examples.en: The funding loan covered construction until permanent financing took over.
examples.zh: 「融资借款」撑过施工期，直到长期融资接手。

examples.en: Interest on the funding loan capitalized into the project's cost.
examples.zh: 「融资借款」的利息资本化计入了项目成本。

words.enDefinition: a fund of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: The trust's fund of capital must never fall below the founding gift.
examples.zh: 信托的「资本基金」绝不能跌破创始捐赠的规模。

examples.en: Only income, never the fund of capital itself, pays the scholarships.
examples.zh: 奖学金只能由收益支付，绝不能动「资本基金」本金。

words.enDefinition: an obligation related to fund

examples.en: Future benefit payments are the pension fund's largest fund liability.
examples.zh: 未来的给付义务是养老「基金负债」中最大的一项。

examples.en: Auditors reprice the entire fund liability whenever discount rates move.
examples.zh: 折现率一动，审计就要重估全部「基金负债」。

words.enDefinition: a fund set up for government investors

examples.en: The fund for government investors buys only bonds of allied states.
examples.zh: 「政府投资者基金」只买盟友国家的债券。

examples.en: Returns from the fund for government investors bankroll the infrastructure plan.
examples.zh: 「政府投资者基金」的收益为基建计划提供资金。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in beginning transactions

examples.en: The day's beginning price set the tone before breakfast was finished.
examples.zh: 开盘的「股票买入价格」在早餐还没吃完时就定了调。

examples.en: Compare the beginning price with the close to gauge the whole session.
examples.zh: 用开盘「股票买入价格」对比收盘价，就知道全天成色。

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to gain on

examples.en: Gain on investments from the parking lot paid for the organ repair.
examples.zh: 停车场带来的「投资收益」，正好付清了管风琴的修缮费。

examples.en: Report gain on investments separately from operating income, auditors insist.
examples.zh: 审计师要求把「投资收益」与经营收入分开列报。

words.enDefinition: the gain realised when bonds are retired or redeemed below their carrying value

examples.en: Buying the notes at ninety-three created a gain on bond retirement.
examples.zh: 以93的价格回购票据，产生了「债券赎回收益」。

examples.en: The gain on bond retirement flows through the income statement once.
examples.zh: 「债券赎回收益」只在利润表中确认一次。

words.enDefinition: a locked box rented in a bank vault for valuables

examples.en: Grandpa's safe deposit box holds war medals nobody else may touch.
examples.zh: 祖父的「银行保险箱」里放着谁都不许碰的战争勋章。

examples.en: Rent a safe deposit box before the gallery tour, not after.
examples.zh: 出借画作巡展之前，先租好「银行保险箱」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning future exchange

examples.en: The future exchange contract locks the dollar rate for next March.
examples.zh: 这份「远期外汇买卖合同」把明年三月的美元汇率锁死了。

examples.en: Breaking a future exchange contract early costs the full reversal spread.
examples.zh: 提前终止「远期外汇买卖合同」，要付足额的反向价差。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to scrip

examples.en: The company offered a scrip dividend instead of cash during the squeeze.
examples.zh: 资金紧张期间，公司以「临时股息」代替现金分红。

examples.en: Shareholders who took the scrip dividend ended up with more shares.
examples.zh: 选择「临时股息」的股东，最终持股反而变多了。

words.enDefinition: a contract whose final price is set as the futures price plus an agreed basis

examples.en: The grain elevator signed a basis contract at minus twenty cents.
examples.zh: 谷仓签下「基差合同」，基差定为贴水20美分。

examples.en: A basis contract lets farmers lock the basis while futures still move.
examples.zh: 「基差合同」让农民锁定基差，期价则随行就市。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from defensive

examples.en: Utilities and staples form the classic defensive investment sleeve of the portfolio.
examples.zh: 公用事业与必需消费品是组合中经典的「防卫性的投资」部分。

examples.en: Her defensive investment stance cost returns in the bull run but saved the year after.
examples.zh: 「防卫性的投资」姿态在牛市里少赚，却在随后的暴跌中保住了本金。

words.enDefinition: a resource controlled by an entity related to fund

examples.en: Each fund asset is ring-fenced from the hospital's general accounts.
examples.zh: 每一项「（专用）基金资产」都与医院一般账户严格隔离。

examples.en: Donors restrict what each fund asset may be spent on.
examples.zh: 捐赠人限定每一项「（专用）基金资产」的用途。

words.enDefinition: units of ownership related to unquoted

examples.en: Valuing unquoted shares leans on comparable deals, not daily prices.
examples.zh: 「未上市股票」的估值靠可比交易，而非每日行情。

examples.en: Employees holding unquoted shares waited years for any kind of exit.
examples.zh: 持有「未上市股票」的员工，等了好几年才等到退出机会。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with unproductive

examples.en: Land banking ties up unproductive capital that could fund machines.
examples.zh: 囤地占压的「非生产性的资本」，本可以拿去买设备。

examples.en: Economists of that school measured unproductive capital with deep suspicion.
examples.zh: 那个学派的经济学家审视「非生产性的资本」时满怀警惕。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in ending transactions

examples.en: The ending price of the session printed just above support.
examples.zh: 当日收盘的「股票卖出价格」刚好停在支撑位上方。

examples.en: Compare the ending price across three venues before declaring the fix.
examples.zh: 宣布修复之前，先对比三个交易场所的「股票卖出价格」。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for employee's insurance

examples.en: Two percent of wages flows into the employee's insurance fund monthly.
examples.zh: 每月工资的2%流入「职工保险基金」。

examples.en: Maternity claims drew the employee's insurance fund down sharply last year.
examples.zh: 去年生育给付让「职工保险基金」余额大幅下降。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for employee pension

examples.en: The employee pension fund owns the office tower the company leases.
examples.zh: 「职工退休金基金」持有公司租用的那栋写字楼。

examples.en: Contributions to the employee pension fund pause automatically during furloughs.
examples.zh: 休耕假期间，「职工退休金基金」的缴存自动暂停。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from uninsurable

examples.en: War is the textbook uninsurable risk, whatever the premium offered.
examples.zh: 战争是教科书级的「不可保的风险」，出多高保费都没用。

examples.en: Regulators ban insurers from writing uninsurable risk to chase yield.
examples.zh: 监管禁止保险公司为追逐收益承保「不可保的风险」。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to unlisted

examples.en: Heirloom unlisted stock from the family mill trades by handshake.
examples.zh: 家族老磨坊的「非上市股票」，靠握手就能成交。

examples.en: Estate valuers price unlisted stock at heavy discounts for illiquidity.
examples.zh: 遗产估价师给「非上市股票」打上很重的流动性折扣。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to unlisted

examples.en: Unlisted securities settle through lawyers rather than through any clearinghouse.
examples.zh: 「非挂牌证券」的交割走律师程序，不经任何清算所。

examples.en: Placement fees on unlisted securities can quietly hit five percent.
examples.zh: 「非挂牌证券」的募集费用可能悄悄高达5%。

words.zhGloss: 交易未上市证券的市场
words.enDefinition: a market for unlisted
acceptedZhAnswers: 交易未上市证券的市场

examples.en: The old unlisted market matched buyers and sellers through a printed bulletin.
examples.zh: 早期的「交易未上市证券的市场」靠一份油印简报撮合买卖双方。

examples.en: Prices in the unlisted market move by appointment, not by auction.
examples.zh: 「交易未上市证券的市场」里，价格靠约定生成，而非竞价。

collocations: clear goods through the unlisted market

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for endowment

examples.en: The endowment fund's income keeps the library open every Sunday.
examples.zh: 「留本基金」的收益让图书馆每周日都能开门。

examples.en: Spending from the endowment fund is capped at four percent a year.
examples.zh: 「留本基金」每年的支出上限为4%。

words.enDefinition: dividend that has been paid

examples.en: Dividend paid in March matched the amount declared in January.
examples.zh: 3月支付的「本期已支付股息」与1月宣告金额一致。

examples.en: Cash flow statements show dividend paid alongside the financing section.
examples.zh: 现金流量表把「本期已支付股息」列在筹资活动之下。

words.enDefinition: money received from dividend

examples.en: Dividend income from the utility shares covers the property tax bill.
examples.zh: 公用事业股的「股利收益」正好缴清房产税。

examples.en: Retirees report their dividend income on the simpler tax form.
examples.zh: 退休族在简易税表上申报「股利收益」。

words.enDefinition: a book recording dividend payment

examples.en: The dividend payment book goes back to the 1930s, every line handwritten.
examples.zh: 这本「股利支付簿」从上世纪30年代记起，每一行都是手写。

examples.en: Clerks balanced the dividend payment book against the bank slip each week.
examples.zh: 职员每周拿「股利支付簿」与银行回单核对。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting dividend payment

examples.en: The dividend payment sheet lists every holder, address, and amount.
examples.zh: 「股利支付表」逐一列明持有人、地址与金额。

examples.en: Sign off the dividend payment sheet before the checks are printed.
examples.zh: 支票打印之前，「股利支付表」必须签字确认。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with dividend from

examples.en: A dividend from capital returns investors' own money, not earned profit.
examples.zh: 「资本股利」返还的是投资人自己的本金，而非赚来的利润。

examples.en: Lawyers flagged the payout as a dividend from capital, which the charter forbids.
examples.zh: 律师指出这笔派息属于章程禁止的「资本股利」。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for dividend

examples.en: Dividend funds hold only companies with five straight years of payouts.
examples.zh: 「股利基金」只持有连续五年派息的公司。

examples.en: Retirees rotate between bond ladders and dividend funds as rates move.
examples.zh: 利率一变，退休族就在债券阶梯与「股利基金」之间挪仓位。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track dividend bank

examples.en: Every check cleared through the dividend bank account before mailing.
examples.zh: 每张支票先从「银行股利存款专户」清算，再寄出。

examples.en: Reconciling the dividend bank account took the clerk one afternoon.
examples.zh: 核对「银行股利存款专户」花了职员整整一个下午。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with diversified investment

examples.en: A diversified investment company spreads capital across energy, freight, and retail.
examples.zh: 这家「多元化投资公司」把资本铺在能源、货运和零售上。

examples.en: One lawsuit can sink a concentrated fund; a diversified investment company survives it.
examples.zh: 一场官司能拖垮单一持仓的基金，「多元化投资公司」却能挺过去。

collocations: bank with the diversified investment company

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from diversified

examples.en: Diversified investment across three continents saved the fund during the regional crash.
examples.zh: 横跨三大洲的「多样化投资」让基金在区域股灾中幸存。

examples.en: Grandma preached diversified investment long before the textbooks formalized it.
examples.zh: 早在教科书把它理论化之前，祖母就在传讲「多样化投资」。

words.enDefinition: a dividend that has been declared but may not yet be paid

examples.en: The dividend declared in November reaches shareholders' accounts in December.
examples.zh: 11月宣告的「议决分派的股利」，12月就会到股东账上。

examples.en: Once dividend declared is booked, the cash is legally committed.
examples.zh: 「议决分派的股利」一经入账，这笔现金在法律上就已作出承诺。

words.enDefinition: dividend that has been earned

examples.en: Dividend earned in the quarter posts automatically to the income account.
examples.zh: 本季度「股利（息）收入」自动计入收益科目。

examples.en: Tax rules treat dividend earned quite differently from interest received.
examples.zh: 税法对「股利（息）收入」与利息收入的处理大不相同。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for dividend equalization

examples.en: The dividend equalization reserve smooths payouts between fat years and lean ones.
examples.zh: 「股利均衡化准备」让丰年和歉年的派息保持平稳。

examples.en: Trustees topped up the dividend equalization reserve before declaring anything.
examples.zh: 宣告分红之前，受托人先把「股利均衡化准备」补足。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for disbursements from

examples.en: Disbursements from fund always require two signatures, never just one.
examples.zh: 「（动用）基金支付」必须双人签字，一人说了不算。

examples.en: Late disbursements from fund pushed the contractor into penalty territory.
examples.zh: 「（动用）基金支付」一再拖延，承包商开始吃罚息。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from ultimate

examples.en: Reinsurance contracts allocate ultimate risk back to the original insurer above the layer.
examples.zh: 超出分层部分，「最终风险」仍由原保险人承担。

examples.en: Regulators assess ultimate risk across the whole group, not per entity.
examples.zh: 监管按集团整体评估「最终风险」，而非逐个法人。

words.enDefinition: a bank appointed to act as agent for a syndicate or facility

examples.en: The agent bank collects interest and distributes it among the lenders.
examples.zh: 「代理银行」负责归集利息，再分派给各参贷行。

examples.en: Notice provisions name the agent bank for every borrower request.
examples.zh: 借款人的所有申请，通知条款都指定发给「代理银行」。

words.enDefinition: a reduction from the normal amount for unamortized bond

examples.en: Unamortized bond discount shrinks a little with every coupon entry.
examples.zh: 每记一次付息，「未摊销债券折价」就减少一点。

examples.en: The balance sheet lists unamortized bond discount beneath the long-term debt line.
examples.zh: 资产负债表把「未摊销债券折价」列在长期负债项下。

words.enDefinition: a turnover of investment used in professional practice

examples.en: Turnover of investment in the trading arm doubled after automation.
examples.zh: 自动化之后，交易板块的「投资周转率（额）」翻倍。

examples.en: Low turnover of investment signals a patient, buy-and-hold style portfolio.
examples.zh: 「投资周转率（额）」低，说明这是一个耐心的买入持有型组合。

words.enDefinition: a turnover of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: Grocery chains live on fast turnover of capital; shipyards never can.
examples.zh: 连锁超市靠「资本的周转率」吃饭，船厂做不到。

examples.en: Halving inventory doubled the turnover of capital within one season.
examples.zh: 库存减半后，「资本的周转率」一个季度就翻倍。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from turnover of all

examples.en: Turnover of all investment across the group reached four times this year.
examples.zh: 集团今年「总投资周转率」达到4次。

examples.en: Comparing turnover of all investment across divisions exposed the laggards.
examples.zh: 对比各部门的「总投资周转率」，落后者立刻现形。

collocations: arrange the turnover of all investment
monitor the turnover of all investment
repay the turnover of all investment

words.enDefinition: a capital metric or concept concerning turnover of all

examples.en: Asset-light models push the turnover of all capital above three.
examples.zh: 轻资产模式能把「总资本周转率」推到3以上。

examples.en: The merger diluted turnover of all capital until synergies appeared.
examples.zh: 并购一度稀释了「总资本周转率」，直到协同效应显现。

collocations: calculate the turnover of all capital
compare the turnover of all capital
reduce the turnover of all capital

words.enDefinition: a turn of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: One turn of capital a year is respectable for shipbuilding.
examples.zh: 造船业一年「资本周转次数」能达到1次就算体面。

examples.en: Fast fashion targets six turns of capital within twelve months.
examples.zh: 快时尚的目标是一年跑出6次「资本周转次数」。

words.enDefinition: a capital metric or concept concerning turnover of working

examples.en: Turnover of working capital rose as customers paid faster on invoice terms.
examples.zh: 客户按发票条件加快付款，「运用资本周转率」随之上升。

examples.en: A slump in turnover of working capital usually shows up first in receivables.
examples.zh: 「运用资本周转率」失速，最先反映在应收账款上。

collocations: calculate the turnover of working capital
compare the turnover of working capital
reduce the turnover of working capital

words.enDefinition: a turnover rate of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: The turnover rate of capital tells you how hard every dollar works.
examples.zh: 「资本周转率」告诉你每一块钱有多卖力。

examples.en: Wholesalers brag about a turnover rate of capital near eight.
examples.zh: 批发商炫耀自家「资本周转率」接近8。

collocations: calculate the turnover rate of capital
compare the turnover rate of capital
reduce the turnover rate of capital

words.enDefinition: a turnover ratio of capital used in professional practice

examples.en: A rising turnover ratio of capital suggests demand, not just efficiency.
examples.zh: 「资本周转率」上升，说明的不只是效率，还有需求。

examples.en: Compare the turnover ratio of capital across five years before praising management.
examples.zh: 夸管理层之前，先看五年的「资本周转率」走势。

collocations: calculate the turnover ratio of capital
compare the turnover ratio of capital
interpret the turnover ratio of capital

words.enDefinition: disbursement of dividends used in professional practice

examples.en: The disbursement of dividends clears on the tenth of each quarter.
examples.zh: 每季度10日完成「支付股息」的清算。

examples.en: Banks held the disbursement of dividends until the audit letter arrived.
examples.zh: 审计函未到，银行暂缓了「支付股息」。

words.enDefinition: discount arising when bonds are purchased below par

examples.en: Buying at ninety-two recorded a discount on bonds purchased of eight points.
examples.zh: 以92买入，确认了8个点的「购入债券（公司债）折价」。

examples.en: Discount on bonds purchased amortizes into income over the holding period.
examples.zh: 「购入债券（公司债）折价」在持有期内摊入收益。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the discount on type

examples.en: Discount on bonds widened sharply as the restructuring rumors spread.
examples.zh: 重组传闻四起，「债券折价」急剧扩大。

examples.en: Issue at eighty-five and the discount on bonds amortizes back to par.
examples.zh: 以85的价格发行，「债券折价」将在存续期内摊回面值。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to discount on

examples.en: Discount on securities at year-end flows through the fair-value reserve.
examples.zh: 年末的「证券折价」计入公允价值准备。

examples.en: Auditors recalculate discount on securities with closing prices, not stale ones.
examples.zh: 审计师用收盘价而非过期报价重算「证券折价」。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for enterprise

examples.en: The city's enterprise funds run the water and parking operations.
examples.zh: 市里的「企业基金」负责供水和停车业务运营。

examples.en: Enterprise funds must cover costs from user fees, not taxes.
examples.zh: 「企业基金」必须靠用户收费覆盖成本，不能靠税收。

words.enDefinition: income from equity investments, such as dividends or the investor's share of profit

examples.en: Equity income from the associate shows the group's share of its profit.
examples.zh: 联营公司的「权益收益」按集团应占利润列示。

examples.en: Equity income grew even though the associate paid no dividend.
examples.zh: 联营公司虽未分红，「权益收益」照样增长。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from equity capital

examples.en: Equity capital turnover of three means each dollar of equity generates three of sales.
examples.zh: 「产权资本周转率」为3，即每1元权益资本创造3元销售额。

examples.en: Asset-light retailers post the highest equity capital turnover in the sector.
examples.zh: 轻资产零售商的「产权资本周转率」冠绝同业。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for agency and trust

examples.en: Agency and trust funds hold taxes collected on behalf of the state.
examples.zh: 「代理和信托基金」保管着代州政府征收的税款。

examples.en: Agency and trust funds never enter the city's own revenue.
examples.zh: 「代理和信托基金」绝不计入城市自有收入。

collocations: arrange the agency and trust funds
monitor the agency and trust funds
repay the agency and trust funds

words.enDefinition: banking related to wholesale

examples.en: Wholesale banking serves corporates and funds, never the walk-in customer.
examples.zh: 「银行批发业务」服务企业和基金，从不面对散客。

examples.en: Fee income drives wholesale banking more than deposit spreads do.
examples.zh: 在「银行批发业务」里，手续费收入比存款利差更重要。

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy covering with profits risks

examples.en: A with profits policy shares the fund's gains with the policyholder.
examples.zh: 「分红保险单」让保单持有人分享基金收益。

examples.en: Bonuses on the with profits policy were cut twice this decade.
examples.zh: 这十年间，「分红保险单」的红利已被削减两次。

words.enDefinition: an account operated through the bank

examples.en: Suppliers prefer settlement by account through the bank for the audit trail.
examples.zh: 供应商偏爱「通过银行结算」，图的是可追溯的审计线索。

examples.en: Cash deals died out once account through the bank became standard.
examples.zh: 「通过银行结算」成为惯例后，现金交易就绝迹了。

collocations: partner with the account through the bank
switch to the account through the bank
evaluate the account through the bank

words.enDefinition: capital associated with absolute fixed

examples.en: Absolute fixed capital counts only blast furnaces, not the land beneath.
examples.zh: 「纯粹固定资本」只算高炉本体，不算下面的土地。

examples.en: Depreciation of absolute fixed capital runs on a straight line over forty years.
examples.zh: 「纯粹固定资本」按四十年直线法折旧。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to yield

examples.en: The project's yield rate of nine percent clears the county's hurdle.
examples.zh: 项目「收益率」9%，跨过了县里的门槛。

examples.en: Compare each bond's yield rate before chasing the biggest coupon.
examples.zh: 追高票息之前，先比较每支债券的「收益率」。

words.enDefinition: a market for dual exchange

examples.en: The dual exchange market priced the official peso at half the parallel one.
examples.zh: 在「双重外汇市场」下，官方比索只有平行市场的一半价格。

examples.en: Arbitrageurs drained reserves from the dual exchange market within months.
examples.zh: 套利者几个月内就把「双重外汇市场」的储备抽干了。

words.enDefinition: the market where bankers' acceptances and similar trade bills are traded

examples.en: The acceptance market prices trade bills by the drawer's credit.
examples.zh: 「承兑市场」按出票人的信用为商业票据定价。

examples.en: Rates in the acceptance market firmed as shipping volumes returned.
examples.zh: 航运量回升后，「承兑市场」利率随之走高。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for working

examples.en: A working fund of one month's expenses keeps the clinic calm.
examples.zh: 留足一个月开销的「周转金」，诊所就心里不慌。

examples.en: Reimbursements from the state refill the working fund every quarter.
examples.zh: 州里的返还款每季度为「周转金」回血。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from working capital

examples.en: Working capital turnover of six says every dollar circulates six times a year.
examples.zh: 「运用（流动）资本周转率」为6，即每块钱一年转六圈。

examples.en: Stretching payables lifted working capital turnover without touching sales at all.
examples.zh: 拉长应付账期，销售额分毫未动，「运用（流动）资本周转率」却上去了。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from working capital

examples.en: Working capital investment in inventory doubled before the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 节前备货让「流动资本投资」翻倍。

examples.en: Cutting working capital investment too far emptied the shelves by November.
examples.zh: 「流动资本投资」砍得太狠，十一月货架就空了。

words.enDefinition: dividends that has been earned

examples.en: Dividends earned on the bank stake covered the club's insurance premium.
examples.zh: 银行股权的「股利收益」付清了俱乐部的保费。

examples.en: The schedule separates dividends earned from dividends merely declared on paper.
examples.zh: 附表区分「股利收益」与仅账面宣告的股利。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from activity

examples.en: Factory building dominates the region's activity investment for this year.
examples.zh: 今年该地区的「投资活动」以建厂为主。

examples.en: National accounts classify activity investment by sector and by asset.
examples.zh: 国民核算按行业和资产类别归集「投资活动」。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to venture

examples.en: Her venture business turns spent coffee grounds into packaging pellets.
examples.zh: 她的「风险企业」把咖啡渣变成包装颗粒。

examples.en: Nine in ten venture businesses fail, and the one that works pays for all.
examples.zh: 十家「风险企业」九家会倒，成功的那一家能养活全部。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for venture expansion

examples.en: The venture expansion fund takes equity in promising startups instead of interest.
examples.zh: 「企业发展基金」投有前景的初创企业，拿股权而不是收利息。

examples.en: Profits recycled into the venture expansion fund built the second plant.
examples.zh: 滚入「企业发展基金」的利润建起了第二座工厂。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates earnings price

examples.en: An earnings price ratio of eight percent equals a price-to-earnings of twelve and a half.
examples.zh: 「盈利价格比」8%，相当于约12.5倍的市盈率。

examples.en: Old textbooks quote the earnings price ratio; newer ones quote its inverse.
examples.zh: 老教材讲「盈利价格比」，新教材讲它的倒数。

words.enDefinition: the worth assigned to earnings capitalized

examples.en: Dividing profit by the discount rate gives the earnings capitalized value.
examples.zh: 利润除以折现率，就得出「收益资本化价值」。

examples.en: The earnings capitalized value of the route justified the franchise fee.
examples.zh: 这条航线的「收益资本化价值」撑得起特许经营权费。

words.enDefinition: distributions of profits related to accumulated

examples.en: Accumulated dividends on the preferred reach nine dollars a share.
examples.zh: 优先股的「累计股利」已达到每股9美元。

examples.en: Nothing goes to common shareholders until accumulated dividends are cleared.
examples.zh: 「累计股利」结清之前，普通股股东一分钱都拿不到。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by takeout

examples.en: A takeout loan replaced the bridge financing once the building stabilized.
examples.zh: 楼宇出租率稳定后，一笔「置换贷款」换掉了过桥融资。

examples.en: Lenders pre-agree the takeout loan before breaking ground on anything.
examples.zh: 动工之前，放贷方就要先敲定「置换贷款」安排。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for development loan

examples.en: The development loan fund finances irrigation canals at three percent.
examples.zh: 「开发贷款基金」以3%的利率支持灌溉渠建设。

examples.en: Repayments recycle into the development loan fund for the next village.
examples.zh: 还回的款项重新滚入「开发贷款基金」，贷给下一个村子。

words.zhGloss: 收费标准协定的保险公司
words.enDefinition: companies engaged in tariff
acceptedZhAnswers: 收费标准协定的保险公司

examples.en: Tariff companies charge identical fire rates agreed by the association.
examples.zh: 「收费标准协定的保险公司」按行业协会统一的费率承保火险。

examples.en: Tariff companies dominated the market before deregulation opened up pricing.
examples.zh: 费率放开之前，市场由「收费标准协定的保险公司」主导。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by fiduciary

examples.en: A fiduciary loan rests purely on the borrower's character and record.
examples.zh: 「信用贷款（放款）」全凭借款人的人品与信用记录。

examples.en: Her fiduciary loan cleared in two days because the credit file was spotless.
examples.zh: 她的信用档案一尘不染，「信用贷款」两天就批了下来。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with financial

examples.en: Financial capital flowed into the port city as the free zone opened.
examples.zh: 自贸区一开，「金融资本」就涌进了这座港口城市。

examples.en: Industrialists complain that financial capital chases quick exits, not factories.
examples.zh: 实业家抱怨「金融资本」只追逐快进快出，不建工厂。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning straight

examples.en: The parent extended straight credit to the subsidiary at no markup.
examples.zh: 母公司给子公司提供「直接信用贷款」，不加任何加点。

examples.en: Straight credit between affiliates needs arm's-length documentation for the tax office.
examples.zh: 关联方之间的「直接信用贷款」要按公允价格备好文件，应付税务核查。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the straight type

examples.en: Straight bonds pay a fixed coupon with no conversion tricks attached.
examples.zh: 「一般公司债券」支付固定票息，不带任何可转换花样。

examples.en: Investors priced the convertible above straight bonds of the same maturity.
examples.zh: 同期限下，可转债的定价高于「一般公司债券」。

words.enDefinition: management of financial

examples.en: Disciplined financial management carried the cooperative safely through two droughts.
examples.zh: 严格的「财务管理」让合作社平稳熬过两场旱灾。

examples.en: Her financial management course assigns a real charity budget to each team.
examples.zh: 她的「财务管理」课给每个小组布置一份真实的慈善机构预算。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from financial

examples.en: Financial investment in the fund favors short Treasuries over anything exotic.
examples.zh: 该基金的「金融投资」只配短期国债，不碰任何花哨品种。

examples.en: Distinguish financial investment in paper assets from real factories and land.
examples.zh: 要区分纸面资产的「金融投资」与真实的工厂和土地。

words.enDefinition: the current yield of a bond, its coupon divided by the market price, ignoring capital gains

examples.en: The straight yield of seven percent ignores what you paid above par.
examples.zh: 「直接收益率」7%，并不考虑你高于面值支付的溢价。

examples.en: Compare straight yield with yield to maturity before praising the coupon.
examples.zh: 夸票息之前，先把「直接收益率」和到期收益率比一比。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with artificial

examples.en: Machines, roads, and irrigation count as artificial capital in national accounts.
examples.zh: 国民核算把机器、道路和灌溉设施都算作「人造资本」。

examples.en: Genuine saving subtracts the depletion of nature from growth in artificial capital.
examples.zh: 真实储蓄要用「人造资本」的增长扣减自然资源的消耗。

words.enDefinition: a retirement savings fund that invests contributions to provide benefits in retirement (common term in Australia and some other jurisdictions)

examples.en: Her superannuation fund switches to defensive assets automatically at sixty.
examples.zh: 她的「养老基金」会在60岁自动转为防御型资产。

examples.en: Choice of superannuation fund matters more than most employees realize.
examples.zh: 「养老基金」的选择，比多数雇员以为的更重要。

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦存款保险公司
words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in federal deposit insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦存款保险公司

examples.en: The federal deposit insurance corporation paid depositors within a week of the failure.
examples.zh: 银行倒闭后一周内，「美国联邦存款保险公司」就完成了对储户的兑付。

examples.en: Deposits at member banks are covered by the federal deposit insurance corporation.
examples.zh: 成员银行的存款都在「美国联邦存款保险公司」保障范围内。

collocations: calculate the federal deposit insurance corporation
compare the federal deposit insurance corporation
interpret the federal deposit insurance corporation

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for appropriation

examples.en: Each appropriation fund is capped at the amount the council voted.
examples.zh: 每个「拨款基金」的限额就是议会表决通过的金额。

examples.en: Spending beyond the appropriation fund requires a supplementary vote first.
examples.zh: 超出「拨款基金」的支出，必须先经补充表决。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to supplementary

examples.en: Strong trading let the board declare a supplementary dividend in October.
examples.zh: 业绩强劲，董事会在10月宣布派发「追加股息」。

examples.en: A supplementary dividend always follows the regular payment, never replaces it.
examples.zh: 「追加股息」只跟随常规分红之后，从不取而代之。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to fictitious

examples.en: Auditors traced the fictitious dividend to an entry with no cash behind it.
examples.zh: 审计师发现这笔「虚构股利」背后的分录根本没有现金支撑。

examples.en: Directors who authorize a fictitious dividend can face personal disqualification.
examples.zh: 批准「虚构股利」的董事可能被取消任职资格。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning subsidiary

examples.en: The subsidiary credit from head office carries no interest for the first year.
examples.zh: 总公司提供的「辅助信用贷款」第一年免息。

examples.en: Branches may only draw subsidiary credit within the approved ceiling.
examples.zh: 分支机构只能在核定额度内动用「辅助信用贷款」。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with transfer

examples.en: The agreement permits transfer capital between affiliates at book value.
examples.zh: 协议允许关联方之间按账面价值「转让资本」。

examples.en: Transferring capital out of the venture needs two-thirds approval first.
examples.zh: 「转让资本」出合伙企业，须先取得三分之二同意。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from exchange

examples.en: Exchange risk turned the Argentinian contract profitable on paper, worthless in cash.
examples.zh: 「外汇风险」让阿根廷合同账面盈利、现金打水漂。

examples.en: Natural hedging halves exchange risk when costs sit in the same currency.
examples.zh: 成本与收入同币种时，自然对冲能把「外汇风险」砍掉一半。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from total capital

examples.en: Total capital turnover of four marks the discount retailer as exceptionally efficient.
examples.zh: 「总资本周转率」达到4，这家折扣零售商效率惊人。

examples.en: Heavy plant dilutes total capital turnover, whatever the sales growth.
examples.zh: 重资产会稀释「总资本周转率」，销售涨得再快也没用。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates total capital profit

examples.en: A total capital profit ratio of eight percent beats most industrial peers.
examples.zh: 「总资本利润率」8%，已胜过多数工业同行。

examples.en: Track the total capital profit ratio after refinancing, not just before.
examples.zh: 「总资本利润率」要在再融资之后跟踪，而不是只看之前。

collocations: calculate the total capital profit ratio
compare the total capital profit ratio
interpret the total capital profit ratio

words.enDefinition: a movement of funds or positions related to trade capital

examples.en: Trade capital movement followed the container routes east within a decade.
examples.zh: 十年间，「贸易资本流动」跟着集装箱航线一路东移。

examples.en: Economists chart trade capital movement against freight rates for clues.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「贸易资本流动」与运价放在一起找线索。

words.enDefinition: a bank specialising in trade finance

examples.en: The trade bank discounts export bills that other lenders refuse.
examples.zh: 别家不敢接的出口票据，这家专做贸易的「商业银行」照单贴现。

examples.en: Our trade bank issued the letter of credit within one morning.
examples.zh: 我们的「商业银行」一个上午就开出了信用证。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from trade

examples.en: Trade investment from the anchor tenant anchored the whole mall project.
examples.zh: 主力商户的「商业投资」稳住了整个购物中心项目。

examples.en: Trade investment between the two groups deepened after the joint venture.
examples.zh: 合资之后，两集团相互的「商业投资」进一步加深。

words.enDefinition: business activity related to trust and investment

examples.en: Trust and investment business grew once deposit rates were freed.
examples.zh: 存款利率放开后，「信托和投资企业」迅速壮大。

examples.en: Regulators licensed the trust and investment business separately from brokers.
examples.zh: 「信托和投资企业」的牌照与券商分开发放。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for trust and agency

examples.en: Trust and agency funds hold escrow monies for pending court cases.
examples.zh: 「信托及代理基金」保管着未决诉讼的托管款项。

examples.en: Interest earned on trust and agency funds belongs to the beneficiaries.
examples.zh: 「信托及代理基金」产生的利息归受益人所有。

collocations: arrange the trust and agency funds
monitor the trust and agency funds
repay the trust and agency funds

words.enDefinition: a market for exchange

examples.en: The exchange market in Lagos trades naira for dollars by phone.
examples.zh: 拉各斯的「外汇市场」靠电话撮合奈拉与美元的交易。

examples.en: Central bank surveys read the exchange market better than any model.
examples.zh: 在研判行情上，央行的调研比任何模型都更懂「外汇市场」。

words.enDefinition: management of exchange

examples.en: The agency in charge of exchange management tightened luxury quotas overnight.
examples.zh: 主管「外汇管理」的机构一夜之间收紧了奢侈品配额。

examples.en: Businesses grumbled that exchange management changes faster than the calendar.
examples.zh: 企业抱怨「外汇管理」变得比日历翻页还快。

words.enDefinition: an exchange dealer used in professional practice

examples.en: An exchange dealer quotes two-way prices in a dozen currencies.
examples.zh: 「外汇交易商」对十几种货币进行双边报价。

examples.en: Importers call their exchange dealer before the daily fixing each morning.
examples.zh: 每天定价前，进口商都会先给「外汇交易商」打电话。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to all capital earnings

examples.en: An all capital earnings rate of seven percent justifies the expansion loan.
examples.zh: 「资产总额收益率」7%，足以支撑这笔扩张贷款。

examples.en: The bank tracks all capital earnings rate alongside interest cover.
examples.zh: 银行同时跟踪「资产总额收益率」与利息保障倍数。

collocations: calculate the all capital earnings rate
compare the all capital earnings rate
interpret the all capital earnings rate

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning excess profit

examples.en: Windfall gains qualified the refinery for an excess profit credit.
examples.zh: 暴利让炼油厂获得了「超额利润抵免」资格。

examples.en: The excess profit credit offsets only taxes actually paid that year.
examples.zh: 「超额利润抵免」只能抵减当年实际缴纳的税款。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for exchange

examples.en: The exchange budget caps dollar purchases at the audited forecast.
examples.zh: 「外汇预算」把美元采购额限定在经审计的预测之内。

examples.en: Every deviation from the exchange budget needs a treasury sign-off.
examples.zh: 偏离「外汇预算」的每一笔支出都要资金部签字。

words.enDefinition: a quota for export retention

examples.en: The export retention quota lets the firm keep twenty percent of receipts.
examples.zh: 依「出口外汇保留额」，企业可留成20%的外汇收入。

examples.en: Bureaucrats cut the export retention quota when reserves ran low.
examples.zh: 外储吃紧时，官方下调了「出口外汇保留额」。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from ancillary

examples.en: Servers and software count as ancillary investment beside the main plant.
examples.zh: 相对于主厂，「辅助投资」指的是服务器和软件。

examples.en: Ancillary investment grew to a fifth of total outlays this year.
examples.zh: 今年「辅助投资」已占到总支出的五分之一。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by export

examples.en: An export loan at pre-shipment covers fabric, thread, and wages.
examples.zh: 装运前的「出口贷款」覆盖面料、线材和工资。

examples.en: The export loan repaid itself the week the containers docked.
examples.zh: 集装箱到港那一周，「出口贷款」就自偿了。

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to temporary

examples.en: Temporary investments park the tax refund until the equipment invoice arrives.
examples.zh: 退税先放「短期投资」里，等设备发票到了再动用。

examples.en: Classify temporary investments as current assets on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 资产负债表上，「短期投资」归入流动资产。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for extra-budgetary

examples.en: Extra-budgetary funds financed the stadium without touching the tax base.
examples.zh: 「预算外基金」建起了体育场，没动税收一分钱。

examples.en: Reformers pushed to fold extra-budgetary funds into the published budget.
examples.zh: 改革者主张把「预算外基金」并入公开预算。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to extra

examples.en: The extra dividend of two dollars came on top of the regular one.
examples.zh: 除常规分红外，这次还派了2美元的「额外股利」。

examples.en: Promise no extra dividend you cannot repeat in a lean year.
examples.zh: 「额外股利」说出口前，先想想歉收之年拿什么兑现。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the term type

examples.en: Term bonds mature all at once, unlike the serial kind.
examples.zh: 与分批还本不同，「定期债券」到期一次性还本。

examples.en: The sinking fund softens the blow of term bonds maturing together.
examples.zh: 偿债基金缓解「定期债券」集中到期的冲击。

words.enDefinition: the value of a security after amortising premium or discount to date
acceptedZhAnswers: 用摊还法计算出的证券投资价值

examples.en: The amortized value of the bond drifts toward par each period.
examples.zh: 债券的「摊余价值」随每个期间逐步靠近面值。

examples.en: Book the sale against amortized value, not the original purchase price.
examples.zh: 卖出时按「摊余价值」入账，而不是按原始买价。

words.zhGloss: 显性成本；直接货币支付的成本
words.enDefinition: costs that involve a direct monetary payment for resources used
acceptedZhAnswers: 显性成本；直接货币支付的成本

examples.en: Rent, wages, and materials are explicit costs; forgone interest is not.
examples.zh: 房租、工资和材料是「显性成本」，放弃的利息则不是。

examples.en: Accountants record only explicit costs, which is why economists disagree with them.
examples.zh: 会计只记录「显性成本」，这正是经济学家与他们分歧所在。

words.enDefinition: the conversion or marketplace related to export

examples.en: Export exchange receipts fund the raw material imports for the next run.
examples.zh: 「出口外汇」收入用来支付下一轮生产的原材料进口。

examples.en: The quota allows export exchange to cover dividends only after taxes.
examples.zh: 按配额，「出口外汇」须先完税才能用于分红汇出。

collocations: clear goods through the export exchange

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to export credit

examples.en: Export credit insurance covered ninety percent of the defaulted receivable.
examples.zh: 这笔坏账的90%由「出口信贷保险」赔付。

examples.en: Premiums for export credit insurance rise with the destination's risk grade.
examples.zh: 目的国风险等级越高，「出口信贷保险」保费越贵。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to export credit

examples.en: The export credit rate of four percent beats any commercial borrowing.
examples.zh: 4%的「出口信贷利率」低于任何商业借款。

examples.en: Official support holds the export credit rate below market for strategic goods.
examples.zh: 对战略物资，「出口信贷利率」在官方支持下低于市场水平。

words.enDefinition: protection against loss related to export

examples.en: Export insurance absorbed the loss when the buyer's bank failed.
examples.zh: 买方银行倒闭，损失由「出口保险」承担。

examples.en: Export insurance costs a fraction of what one default would.
examples.zh: 「出口保险」的保费，只是一次违约损失的一个零头。

words.enDefinition: an issue of expenses on bond

examples.en: Expenses on bond issue include legal opinions and rating fees.
examples.zh: 「发行债券费用」包括法律意见书和评级费。

examples.en: Amortize expenses on bond issue over the full twenty-year term.
examples.zh: 「发行债券费用」按二十年期限摊销。

words.enDefinition: a market for insurance

examples.en: The insurance market hardened premiums after three years of hurricanes.
examples.zh: 连续三年飓风之后，「保险市场」保费全面走硬。

examples.en: New insurers entered the insurance market to chase catastrophe pricing.
examples.zh: 高企的巨灾定价引来新玩家进入「保险市场」。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to insurance

examples.en: The insurance dividend returns part of the premium to loyal policyholders.
examples.zh: 「保险股利」把部分保费返还给忠实保单持有人。

examples.en: Mutual insurers pay an insurance dividend because policyholders are the owners.
examples.zh: 相互制保险公司派发「保险股利」，因为保单持有人就是所有者。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for insurance

examples.en: The insurance fund covers claims when a member insurer collapses.
examples.zh: 会员保险公司倒闭时，由「保险基金」兜底赔付。

examples.en: Levies on premiums keep the insurance fund topped up year-round.
examples.zh: 保费征费让「保险基金」全年保持充足。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for insurance fund

examples.en: The insurance fund reserve covers one full year of expected claims.
examples.zh: 「保险基金准备」足以覆盖一整年的预期赔付。

examples.en: Regulators top up the insurance fund reserve whenever loss ratios climb.
examples.zh: 赔付率一抬头，监管就要求增提「保险基金准备」。
